-- Row-definition tables for the Properties panel type sections. Returns a constructor so
-- each buildProperties() call gets fresh tables, exactly as the former locals did.
-- Consumed by BuildProperties.buildProperties via W.buildTypeSection.
--
-- Section vocabulary shared by every type (docs/qp2-roadmap/PANEL_LAYOUT_PROPOSAL.md). Display
-- order is PropertyCatalog.SECTION_RANK: Emission > Appearance (Blender right under it) > Spawn >
-- Motion > other sections in array order > Events > Advanced. A toggle_group's children always
-- render after the section's other rows, so groups sit last in their section.

return function()
	local partDefs = {
		{name = "Emission", rows = {
			{key="EmissionMode", label="Mode", type="dropdown", options={"Emit","Animate"}, default="Emit"},
			{key="AnimateLoop", label="Loop", type="toggle"},
			{key="Enabled", label="Enabled", type="toggle"},
			{key="EmitMode", label="Type", type="dropdown", options={"Auto","Burst"}, default="Auto"},
			{key="Rate", label="Rate", type="input", default="10"},
			{key="Lifetime", label="Lifetime", type="input", default="1, 1", placeholder="min, max"},
			{key="Linger", label="Linger", type="input", default="0", placeholder="seconds"},
			{key="Timescale", label="Timescale", type="graph"},

		{name = "Spawn", collapsed = true, rows = {
			{key="Orientation", label="Orientation", type="dropdown", options={"None","FacingCamera","FacingCameraWorldUp","VelocityParallel","VelocityPerpendicular"}, default="None"},

			{key="RotOrder", label="Rot Order", type="dropdown", options={"Global","LocalXYZ","LocalXZY","LocalYXZ","LocalYZX","LocalZXY","LocalZYX"}, default="Global"},

			{key="ZOffset", label="Z-Offset", type="input", default="0"},

				{key="Shape",            label="Shape",            type="dropdown", options={"Box","Sphere","Cylinder","Disc"}, default="Box"},

			{key="Acceleration", label="Acceleration", type="input", default="0, 0, 0", placeholder="x, y, z"},

-- BuildPropertiesForce  -  property-panel section for the Force type.
-- Same pattern as BuildPropertiesRocks. Consumer: BuildProperties.buildProperties()
-- calls buildSection(scroll, refs) during its build.

local W = require(script.Parent.Widgets)
local buildDefs = require(script.Parent.BuildPropertiesDefs)
local BuildPropertiesForce = {}

-- Spawn, Motion and Link are the mesh's own rows (BuildPropertiesDefs.partDefs), so a row
-- added to a mesh's section reaches the Force. A row left out belongs to something that is
-- drawn. A renamed one would share its key with a row the Force already has: its shape's
-- Direction and its gusts' Turbulence. PropertyInputsForce and PopulateForce read these keys.
local MESH_SECTIONS = { "Spawn", "Motion", "Link" }
local LEFT_OUT = { Orientation = true, ZOffset = true, UseShape = true }
local RENAMED = { Direction = "MoveDirection", Turbulence = "MotionTurbulence" }

-- A mesh section's rows as a Force section, folded until it is wanted.
local function meshSection(partDefs, name)
	for _, section in ipairs(partDefs) do
		if section.name == name then
			local rows = {}
			for _, row in ipairs(section.rows) do
				if not LEFT_OUT[row.key] then
					row.key = RENAMED[row.key] or row.key
					table.insert(rows, row)
				end
			end
			return { name = name, collapsed = true, rows = rows }
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function BuildPropertiesForce.buildSection(scroll, refs)
	-- Shape, Acts As and the rows only some shapes use: Populate/PopulateForce shows and hides
	-- them; the option strings are TypeDataForce.SHAPES and KINDS.
	local forceDefs = {
		{name = "Emission", rows = {
			{key="Enabled",  label="Enabled", type="toggle"},
			{key="EmitMode", label="Type", type="dropdown", options={"Auto","Burst"}, default="Auto"},
			{key="Rate",     label="Rate", type="input", default="2"},
			{key="Lifetime", label="Lifetime", type="input", default="1, 1", placeholder="min, max"},
		}},
		{name = "Shape", rows = {
			{key="Shape",     label="Shape", type="dropdown", options={"Sphere","Cone","Linear","Vortex"}, default="Sphere"},
			{key="Direction", label="Direction", type="dropdown", options={"Front","Back","Top","Bottom","Right","Left"}, default="Front"},
			{key="Range",     label="Range", type="input", default="30"},
			{key="Inner",     label="Inner", type="input", default="0"},
			{key="Width",     label="Width", type="input", default="20"},
			{key="Height",    label="Height", type="input", default="20"},
			{key="Angle",     label="Angle", type="input", default="60"},
		}},
		{name = "Strength", rows = {
			{key="ActsAs",      label="Acts As", type="dropdown", options={"Impulse","Continuous"}, default="Impulse"},
			{key="Strength",    label="Strength", type="graph"},
			{key="Falloff",     label="Falloff", type="input", default="1", placeholder="0 to 1"},
			{key="TravelTime",  label="Travel Time", type="input", default="0", placeholder="seconds"},
			{key="Lift",        label="Lift", type="input", default="0.7"},
			{key="Spin",        label="Spin", type="input", default="1"},
			{key="Pull",        label="Pull", type="input", default="0.5"},
		}},
		{name = "Variation", rows = {
			{key="Variation",    label="Variation", type="input", default="0.2"},
			{key="Turbulence",   label="Turbulence", type="input", default="0"},
			{key="SizeResponse", label="Size Response", type="input", default="0.5"},
			{key="Group",        label="Group", type="input", default="", placeholder="all"},
		}},
	}
	-- A fresh set of mesh rows: the ones the Meshes section was built from are in use.
	local partDefs = buildDefs().partDefs
	for _, name in ipairs(MESH_SECTIONS) do
		local section = meshSection(partDefs, name)
		if section then
			table.insert(forceDefs, section)
		end
	end
	refs.ForceSection, refs.Force = W.buildTypeSection(scroll, "Forces", forceDefs, 3)
	refs.ForceSection.Visible = false
end

return BuildPropertiesForce

--[[
	BuildSettings  -  the Settings panel: auto-emit delay, UI scale, particle cap, the on-off
	settings, and the theme / shortcuts / layout / update buttons.
	Returns build(screenGui) -> refs: SettingsPanel, SettingsClose, AutoEmitDelayBox, UIScaleBox,
	ParticleCapBox, EditThemeButton, ResetLayoutButton, ShortcutsButton, AutoUpdateToggle,
	EdgeSnapToggle, ConsoleOutputToggle, WorkspacesToggle, CheckUpdatesButton.
	Wiring uses these refs by name only (QOLWiring, SettingsToggles, ThemeWiring, Shortcuts/Bootstrap),
	so the two layouts below may arrange them differently: Classic keeps the original boxed
	layout, the other modes use the shared panel chrome.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Widgets)
local PanelSizes = require(script.Parent.PanelSizes)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

local function buildClassic(screenGui)
	local panel = Instance.new("Frame"); panel.Name = "SettingsPanel"
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; panel.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
	-- Anchor bottom-right so the panel hugs just above the toggle bar regardless of
	-- its AutomaticSize.Y height. Toggle bar sits at y=`1, -34` with height 24, so
	-- y=`1, -38` leaves a 4px gap above the bar's top edge.
	panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
	panel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -38)
	panel.Size = UDim2.new(0,LAYOUT.SettingsWidth,0,0); panel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y; panel.Active = true
	panel.ClipsDescendants = false; panel.Visible = false; panel.Parent = screenGui
	W.addCorner(panel, T.BigCorner); W.addStroke(panel); W.addPadding(panel,8,8,8,8); W.addListLayout(panel,4)
	table.insert(W.getThemed().panels, panel)
	W.attachPanelBackground(panel)
	local refs = {}

	local header = W.makeBlob("Header", panel, UDim2.new(1,0,0,24)); header.LayoutOrder = 0

local function buildModern(screenGui)
	local sizes = PanelSizes.get()
	local labelWidth = sizes.SettingsLabel
	local refs = {}

	local panel = W.makePanel(screenGui, "SettingsPanel", sizes.Settings)
	-- Anchored bottom-right so the panel sits just above the toggle bar whatever its height.
	panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
	panel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -(PanelSizes.bottomBarTop() + 4))
	panel.Visible = false

	local bar = W.makeTitleBar(panel, "Settings", 0)
	refs.SettingsClose = bar.close
	W.makeDraggable(panel, bar.dragHandle)

	refs.AutoEmitDelayBox = W.makeNumberRow(panel, "AutoEmitDelay", "AutoEmit Delay", "1", labelWidth, 1)
	refs.UIScaleBox = W.makeNumberRow(panel, "UIScale", "UI Scale %", tostring(C.DEFAULT_UI_SCALE_PERCENT), labelWidth, 2)
	-- The engine skips new emits past this many live particles.
	refs.ParticleCapBox = W.makeNumberRow(panel, "ParticleCap", "Particle Cap", "1000", labelWidth, 3)

	W.makeDivider(panel, 4)

	-- Each is saved with plugin:SetSetting under its name and defaults to on (SettingsToggles).
	refs.AutoUpdateToggle = W.makeSwitchRow(panel, "AutoUpdate", "Auto-Update", 5)
	refs.EdgeSnapToggle = W.makeSwitchRow(panel, "EdgeSnap", "Snap Panels In View", 6)
	refs.ConsoleOutputToggle = W.makeSwitchRow(panel, "ConsoleOutput", "Console Output", 7)
	-- Shortcuts/Runtime rewrites the label with the keys as they are bound.
	local workspacesToggle, _, workspacesLabel = W.makeSwitchRow(panel, "Workspaces", "Workspaces ( /  =  - )", 8)
	workspacesLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	refs.WorkspacesToggle = workspacesToggle
	refs.WorkspacesLabel = workspacesLabel

	W.makeDivider(panel, 9)

	refs.EditThemeButton = W.makeActionButton(panel, "EditTheme", "Edit Theme", 10)
	refs.ShortcutsButton = W.makeActionButton(panel, "Shortcuts", "Shortcuts", 11)
	refs.ResetLayoutButton = W.makeActionButton(panel, "ResetLayout", "Reset Layout", 12)
	-- QOLWiring swaps this label to "Checking..." while a check runs.
	refs.CheckUpdatesButton = W.makeActionButton(panel, "CheckUpdates", "Check for Updates", 13)

	refs.SettingsPanel = panel
	return refs
end

return function(screenGui)
	if C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
		return buildClassic(screenGui)
	end
	return buildModern(screenGui)
end

--[[
	BuildThemeEditor  -  the theme editor: mode and text size, the six theme colours, title font,
	background image, preset, theme code, and Apply / Cancel / Reset.
	Returns build(screenGui) -> refs: ThemeEditor, ModeDropdown, ModeOnChanged, AccentColor,
	BgColor, BlobColor, SliderColor, ScrollBarColor, TextColor (each { hex, swatch }), BgImageBox,
	BgImageOpacityBox, FontDropdown, FontDropdownOnChanged, PresetDropdownLbl, PresetOnChanged,
	ThemeCodeBox, ExportTheme, ImportTheme, ApplyTheme, CancelTheme, ResetTheme; Classic adds
	PanelOpacityBox and BlobOpacityBox, the other modes TextSizeDropdown and TextSizeOnChanged.
	ThemeWiring fills and reads them by name. A mode or text-size change takes effect on Apply,
	which rebuilds the UI. Classic keeps the original layout; the other modes use the shared
	panel chrome.
]]

	-- Opacity convention: slider 0 = fully opaque, slider 100 = fully transparent. Maps

	local function makeOpacityRow(label, lo, defaultAlpha)
		local row = Instance.new("Frame"); row.BackgroundTransparency = 1; row.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,24); row.LayoutOrder = lo; row.Parent = panel

	local bar = W.makeTitleBar(panel, "Theme Editor", 0)
	bar.close:Destroy()
	bar.title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	bar.dragHandle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	W.makeDraggable(panel, bar.dragHandle)

	-- Label on the left, a dropdown filling the rest.
	local function makeChoiceRow(name, label, order, options, current)
		local row = W.makeRowFrame(panel, name .. "Row", order)
		W.makeRowLabel(row, label, labelWidth)
		local valueLabel, wrap, onChanged = W.makeDropdown(name .. "Dropdown", row, options, current)
		wrap.Position = UDim2.new(0, valueOffset, 0, 0)
		wrap.Size = UDim2.new(1, -valueOffset, 1, 0)
		return valueLabel, onChanged
	end

	-- Label, a swatch that opens the colour picker, and the colour's hex code.
	local function makeColorRow(name, label, order, color)
		local row = W.makeRowFrame(panel, name .. "Row", order)
		W.makeRowLabel(row, label, labelWidth)

		local swatch = Instance.new("TextButton")
		swatch.Name = "Swatch"
		swatch.Text = ""
		swatch.AutoButtonColor = false
		swatch.BorderSizePixel = 0
		swatch.BackgroundColor3 = color
		swatch.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		swatch.Position = UDim2.new(0, valueOffset, 0.5, 0)
		swatch.Size = UDim2.new(0, SWATCH, 0, SWATCH)
		-- A user colour: the theme's colour-matching pass must not repaint it.
		swatch:SetAttribute("_noColorRemap", true)
		swatch.Parent = row
		W.addCorner(swatch)
		W.addStroke(swatch)

		local hexOffset = valueOffset + SWATCH + LAYOUT.LabelGap
		local hex, field = W.makeTextField(row, name, C.color3ToHex(color), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
		field.Position = UDim2.new(0, hexOffset, 0, 0)
		field.Size = UDim2.new(1, -hexOffset, 1, 0)
		return { hex = hex, swatch = swatch }
	end

	local sizeNames = {}
	for _, size in ipairs(ThemeModes.TEXT_SIZES) do
		table.insert(sizeNames, tostring(size))
	end
	refs.ModeDropdown, refs.ModeOnChanged = makeChoiceRow("Mode", "Mode", 1, ThemeModes.ORDER, T.Mode)
	refs.TextSizeDropdown, refs.TextSizeOnChanged = makeChoiceRow("TextSize", "Text size", 2, sizeNames, tostring(T.TextSize))
	local presetNames = { "Custom" }
	for _, preset in ipairs(C.THEME_PRESETS) do
		table.insert(presetNames, preset.name)
	end
	refs.PresetDropdownLbl, refs.PresetOnChanged = makeChoiceRow("Preset", "Preset", 3, presetNames, "Custom")

	W.makeDivider(panel, 4)

	refs.AccentColor = makeColorRow("Accent", "Accent", 5, T.InputAccent)
	refs.BgColor = makeColorRow("Background", "Background", 6, T.InputBg)
	refs.BlobColor = makeColorRow("Field", "Field", 7, T.InputBlob)
	refs.SliderColor = makeColorRow("Slider", "Slider", 8, T.InputSlider)
	refs.ScrollBarColor = makeColorRow("ScrollBar", "Scroll bar", 9, T.InputScrollBar)
	refs.TextColor = makeColorRow("Text", "Text", 10, T.TextAccent)

	W.makeDivider(panel, 11)

	refs.FontDropdown, refs.FontDropdownOnChanged = makeChoiceRow("Font", "Title font", 12, C.FONT_OPTIONS, T.Font.Name)

	-- Takes a bare asset id, a full rbxassetid:// link, or nothing; ThemeWiring parses it.
	refs.BgImageBox = W.makeNumberRow(panel, "BgImage", "Background image", T.BgImage or "", labelWidth, 13)
	refs.BgImageBox.PlaceholderText = "rbxassetid://..."
	refs.BgImageBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	refs.BgImageBox.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	TypeScale.style(refs.BgImageBox, "Value")

	-- 0 = solid, 100 = invisible: the value is the image's transparency in percent.
	local imageOpacity = tostring(math.floor(T.BgImageTransparency * 100 + 0.5))
	refs.BgImageOpacityBox = W.makeNumberRow(panel, "BgImageOpacity", "Image opacity %", imageOpacity, labelWidth, 14)

	W.makeDivider(panel, 15)

	local codeRow = W.makeRowFrame(panel, "ThemeCodeRow", 16)
	codeRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row * 2)
	W.makeRowLabel(codeRow, "Theme code", labelWidth)
	local codeBox, codeField = W.makeTextField(codeRow, "ThemeCode", "", Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
	codeField.Position = UDim2.new(0, valueOffset, 0, 0)
	codeField.Size = UDim2.new(1, -valueOffset, 1, 0)
	codeBox.PlaceholderText = "Paste or copy"
	codeBox.TextWrapped = true
	codeBox.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	codeBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.FieldPad, 0, 4)
	codeBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.FieldPad * 2, 1, -8)
	TypeScale.style(codeBox, "Caption")
	refs.ThemeCodeBox = codeBox

	local codeButtons = W.makeButtonRow(panel, "CodeButtons", {
		{ name = "Export", text = "Export" },
		{ name = "Import", text = "Import" },
	}, 17)
	refs.ExportTheme = codeButtons[1]
	refs.ImportTheme = codeButtons[2]

	W.makeDivider(panel, 18)

	local actions = W.makeButtonRow(panel, "Actions", {
		{ name = "Apply", text = "Apply", role = "Success" },
		{ name = "Cancel", text = "Cancel", role = "TextSecondary" },
		{ name = "Reset", text = "Reset", role = "Danger" },
	}, 19)
	refs.ApplyTheme = actions[1]
	refs.CancelTheme = actions[2]
	refs.ResetTheme = actions[3]

	refs.ThemeEditor = panel
	return refs
end

return function(screenGui)
	if C.MODE.Structure.Classic then

--[[
	BuildToolbar  -  the bottom edge of the screen: the particle counter and the optimization
	indicator on the left, the menu button and its strip of panel toggles on the right.
	Returns build(screenGui) -> { counter, counterLabel, optIndicator, optLabel, toggles }, where
	toggles = { emitToggle, propsToggle, counterToggle, qolToggle, settingsToggle, inventoryToggle,
	motionToggle, bar, menuBtn, strip, set }.
	toggles.set(button, on) is the one way a toggle is lit or dimmed. Wiring calls it for the
	toggles that stand for a setting (Emit, Properties, Motion); UIBuilder binds the ones that
	stand for a panel (Counter, Tools, Settings, Inventory) to that panel's Visible, so they
	cannot drift from what is on screen. Every toggle starts dimmed until one of the two sets it.
	Wiring also writes the counter and indicator texts, and shows or hides the two boxes.
	Classic keeps the original layout and lights a toggle through its text colour; the other
	modes use the segmented strip the Inventory's tabs use (WidgetSegments), lit softly and in
	the panels' colour, and size the bar by the theme's row height (PanelSizes.bottomBarTop gives
	panels above it the bar's top).
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Widgets)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.TypeScale)
local PanelSizes = require(script.Parent.PanelSizes)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

local function buildCounter(sg)

	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel"); l.Name = "Label"; l.BackgroundTransparency = 1; l.Text = "0 particles"
	l.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold; l.Font = T.Font; l.TextSize = 10; l.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); l.Parent = c
	return c, l end
local function buildOptIndicator(sg)
	local c = W.makeBlob("OptIndicator", sg, UDim2.new(0,160,0,22)); c.Position = UDim2.new(0,118,1,-34); c.Visible = false
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel"); l.Name = "Label"; l.BackgroundTransparency = 1; l.Text = "Optimization: --"
	l.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold; l.Font = T.Font; l.TextSize = 10; l.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); l.Parent = c

local function buildToggles(sg)
	local bar = Instance.new("Frame"); bar.Name = "ToggleBar"; bar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	bar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	bar.Position = UDim2.new(1,-12,1,-34); bar.Size = UDim2.new(0,0,0,24)
	bar.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X; bar.Parent = sg
	W.addListLayout(bar, 3, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right)

	-- Menu toggle button (always visible, rightmost)
	local menuBtn = W.makeButton("MenuToggle", bar, "\u{2261}", UDim2.new(0,24,0,24), T.Gold)
	menuBtn.TextSize = 16; menuBtn.LayoutOrder = 100

	-- Expandable strip (hidden by default, appears to the left)
	local strip = Instance.new("Frame"); strip.Name = "Strip"; strip.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg
	strip.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha; strip.Size = UDim2.new(0,0,0,24)
	strip.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X; strip.Visible = false; strip.LayoutOrder = 0
	strip.BorderSizePixel = 0; strip.Parent = bar
	W.addCorner(strip, T.Corner); W.addStroke(strip); table.insert(W.getThemed().panels, strip)
	local sp = Instance.new("UIPadding"); sp.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0,3); sp.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0,3); sp.Parent = strip
	local sl = Instance.new("UIListLayout"); sl.Padding = UDim.new(0,3); sl.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	sl.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; sl.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
	sl.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center; sl.Parent = strip

	local function makeStripBtn(name, text, color, lo)
		local b = W.makeButton(name, strip, text, UDim2.new(0,0,0,20), color)
		b.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X; b.TextSize = 9; b.LayoutOrder = lo
		local p = Instance.new("UIPadding"); p.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0,6); p.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0,6); p.Parent = b
		return b
	end

	local eb = makeStripBtn("EmitToggle", "Emit", T.DarkGold, 0)
	local pb = makeStripBtn("PropsToggle", "Properties", T.DarkGold, 1)
	local cb = makeStripBtn("CounterToggle", "Counter", T.DarkGold, 2)
	local qb = makeStripBtn("QolToggle", "Tools", T.DarkGold, 3)
	local sb = makeStripBtn("SettingsToggle", "Settings", T.DarkGold, 4)
	local ib = makeStripBtn("InventoryToggle", "Inventory", T.DarkGold, 5)
	local mb = makeStripBtn("MotionToggle", "Motion", T.DarkGold, 6)

	menuBtn.Activated:Connect(function() strip.Visible = not strip.Visible end)

	local function set(button, on)
		button.TextColor3 = on and T.Gold or T.DarkGold
	end
	return {emitToggle = eb, propsToggle = pb, settingsToggle = sb, counterToggle = cb, qolToggle = qb, inventoryToggle = ib, motionToggle = mb, bar = bar, menuBtn = menuBtn, strip = strip, set = set}
end

local function buildClassic(sg)
	local counter, counterLabel = buildCounter(sg)
	local optIndicator, optLabel = buildOptIndicator(sg)
	return {
		counter = counter, counterLabel = counterLabel,
		optIndicator = optIndicator, optLabel = optLabel,
		toggles = buildToggles(sg),
	}
end

-- Distance of the bar from the left and right screen edges.
local SIDE_MARGIN = 12
-- Text inset inside a status box.
local BOX_PADDING = 10

-- A status box as wide as its text. Returns the box and its label.
local function makeStatusBox(parent, name, text, order)
	local box = W.makeBlob(name, parent, UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0))
	box.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
	box.LayoutOrder = order
	W.addPadding(box, BOX_PADDING, BOX_PADDING, 0, 0)

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "Label"
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
	label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
	TypeScale.style(label, "Label")
	label.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
	label.Parent = box
	return box, label
end

local function buildModern(sg)
	local barTop = PanelSizes.bottomBarTop()
	local barHeight = LAYOUT.Row

	local status = Instance.new("Frame")
	status.Name = "StatusBar"
	status.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	status.Position = UDim2.new(0, SIDE_MARGIN, 1, -barTop)
	status.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, barHeight)
	status.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
	status.Parent = sg
	W.addListLayout(status, LAYOUT.RowGap, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)

	local counter, counterLabel = makeStatusBox(status, "ParticleCounter", "0 particles", 0)
	local optIndicator, optLabel = makeStatusBox(status, "OptIndicator", "Optimization: --", 1)
	optIndicator.Visible = false

	local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
	bar.Name = "ToggleBar"
	bar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	bar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	bar.Position = UDim2.new(1, -SIDE_MARGIN, 1, -barTop)
	bar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, barHeight)
	bar.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
	bar.Parent = sg
	W.addListLayout(bar, LAYOUT.RowGap, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right)

	local menuButton = W.makeActionButton(bar, "MenuToggle", "\u{2261}", 100, "TextHeading")
	menuButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, barHeight, 1, 0)
	TypeScale.style(menuButton, "Glyph")

	-- The strip opens to the left of the menu button. Its toggles only indicate what is on, and
	-- several are lit at once, so they are lit softly.
	local SOFT = { soft = true }
	local strip = W.makeSegmentStrip(bar, "Strip")
	-- The bar floats over the 3D view as the panels do, so its strip takes the panels' colour,
	-- not the field colour a strip has when it sits inside a panel.
	W.paint(strip, "BackgroundColor3", "PanelBg")
	strip.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
	strip.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
	strip.Visible = false
	strip.LayoutOrder = 0

	local toggles = {
		emitToggle = W.makeSegment(strip, "EmitToggle", "Emit", 0, SOFT),
		propsToggle = W.makeSegment(strip, "PropsToggle", "Properties", 1, SOFT),
		counterToggle = W.makeSegment(strip, "CounterToggle", "Counter", 2, SOFT),
		qolToggle = W.makeSegment(strip, "QolToggle", "Tools", 3, SOFT),
		settingsToggle = W.makeSegment(strip, "SettingsToggle", "Settings", 4, SOFT),
		inventoryToggle = W.makeSegment(strip, "InventoryToggle", "Inventory", 5, SOFT),
		motionToggle = W.makeSegment(strip, "MotionToggle", "Motion", 6, SOFT),
		bar = bar, menuBtn = menuButton, strip = strip, set = W.paintSegment,
	}
	menuButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		strip.Visible = not strip.Visible
	end)

	return {
		counter = counter, counterLabel = counterLabel,
		optIndicator = optIndicator, optLabel = optLabel,
		toggles = toggles,
	}
end

return function(sg)
	if C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
		return buildClassic(sg)
	end
	return buildModern(sg)
end

--[[
	ConfigPanel  -  small modal popups for per-property advanced configuration. Currently exposes:

	  openInstancePicker(opts)  -  picks any Instance from Studio Selection.
	    opts.title    : panel title text
	    opts.label    : prompt label above the instance line ("Pick the target")
	    opts.onSet(inst): called when user clicks Set with the currently-selected Instance
	    opts.onCancel() : called when user dismisses

	  openAxisLinkPanel(opts)  -  links the axes of one row (SizeX / SizeY / SizeZ ...).

	  openApplyPanel(opts)  -  which kinds of thing a Container property acts on.
	    opts.title, opts.context : panel title and the property it is for
	    opts.kinds   : { { key = "Emitter", label = "Particle Emitters" }, ... }
	    opts.applies : { [key] = boolean }, the state the panel opens with (missing = true)
	    opts.onSet(applies) : called with the same shape when the user clicks Set
]]

local Log = require(script.Parent.Parent.Part.Log)

local Selection = game:GetService("Selection")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

return function(deps)
	local W = deps.W
	local T = deps.T

	local _activePanel = nil

	local function closeActive()
		if _activePanel then
			pcall(function() _activePanel:close() end)
			_activePanel = nil
		end
	end

	local function openInstancePicker(opts)
		closeActive()

		local screenGui = W.getScreenGui and W.getScreenGui() or deps.screenGui
		if not screenGui then
			Log.warn("[Part-Icles] ConfigPanel: missing ScreenGui  -  cannot open picker")
			return
		end

		local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
		panel.Name = "ConfigPanel_InstancePicker"
		panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg
		panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		-- Tall enough to fit title + context-line + prompt + instance line + buttons.
		panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 138)
		panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
		panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
		panel.ZIndex = 200
		panel.Active = true
		panel:SetAttribute("_opaquePanel", true)
		panel:SetAttribute("_noSnap", true)
		panel.Parent = screenGui
		W.addCorner(panel, T.Corner)
		W.addStroke(panel)
		W.addPadding(panel, 8, 8, 8, 8)
		W.attachPanelBackground(panel)

		-- Title bar
		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Text = opts.title or "Configure"
		title.TextColor3 = T.Gold
		title.Font = T.Font
		title.TextSize = 12
		title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		title.ZIndex = 201
		title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16)
		title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		title.Parent = panel

		-- Context  -  which items this panel is editing. Stays visible even if user changes Studio
		-- Selection while the panel is open.
		if opts.context and opts.context ~= "" then
			local contextLine = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			contextLine.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			contextLine.Text = "for: " .. opts.context
			contextLine.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
			contextLine.Font = T.Font
			contextLine.TextSize = 10
			contextLine.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			contextLine.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
			contextLine.ZIndex = 201
			contextLine.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14)
			contextLine.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 18)
			contextLine.Parent = panel
		end

		local hasContext = opts.context and opts.context ~= ""
		local promptY = hasContext and 40 or 22
		local instanceY = hasContext and 58 or 40

		-- Prompt
		local prompt = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		prompt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		prompt.Text = opts.label or "Select an instance:"
		prompt.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
		prompt.Font = T.Font
		prompt.TextSize = 10
		prompt.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		prompt.ZIndex = 201
		prompt.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14)
		prompt.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, promptY)
		prompt.Parent = panel

		-- Selected-instance label
		local instanceLine = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		instanceLine.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
		instanceLine.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
		instanceLine.Text = "Instance: <nil>"
		instanceLine.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
		instanceLine.Font = T.Font
		instanceLine.TextSize = 11
		instanceLine.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		instanceLine.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		instanceLine.ZIndex = 201
		instanceLine.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
		instanceLine.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, instanceY)
		instanceLine.BorderSizePixel = 0
		instanceLine.Parent = panel
		W.addCorner(instanceLine, UDim.new(0, 4))
		W.addPadding(instanceLine, 6, 6, 0, 0)

		-- Buttons
		local function makeBtn(text, col, x)
			local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
			b.BackgroundColor3 = col
			b.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			b.Text = text
			b.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
			b.Font = T.Font
			b.TextSize = 11
			b.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -3, 0, 22)
			b.Position = UDim2.new(x, x == 0 and 0 or 3, 1, -22)
			b.BorderSizePixel = 0
			b.ZIndex = 201
			b.Parent = panel
			W.addCorner(b, UDim.new(0, 4))
			W.addStroke(b)
			return b
		end
		-- Three buttons when opts.allowClear is set, two otherwise. Clear writes
		-- nil through opts.onClear so picker-managed ObjectValue / direct properties
		-- can be unset without leaving the panel.
		local setBtn, clearBtn, cancelBtn
		if opts.allowClear then
			local function makeBtn3(text, col, x)
				local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
				b.BackgroundColor3 = col; b.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
				b.Text = text; b.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
				b.Font = T.Font; b.TextSize = 11
				b.Size = UDim2.new(1/3, -3, 0, 22)
				b.Position = UDim2.new(x, x == 0 and 0 or 3, 1, -22)
				b.BorderSizePixel = 0; b.ZIndex = 201; b.Parent = panel
				W.addCorner(b, UDim.new(0, 4)); W.addStroke(b)
				return b
			end
			setBtn = makeBtn3("Set", T.BlobBg, 0)
			clearBtn = makeBtn3("Clear", T.BlobBg, 1/3)
			cancelBtn = makeBtn3("Cancel", T.BlobBg, 2/3)
		else
			setBtn = makeBtn("Set", T.BlobBg, 0)
			cancelBtn = makeBtn("Cancel", T.BlobBg, 0.5)
		end

		local _selected = nil
		-- Recency cache: last non-empty Studio Selection observed during this picker's
		-- lifetime. Acts as fallback when Set is clicked and live Selection is empty  - 
		-- happens when clicking the Set button itself clears focus from Studio Explorer
		-- (Studio quirk: focus shifts to plugin GUI → Selection reported as empty mid-click).
		local _selectedCache = nil
		-- Exclude set built from opts.excludeItems (typically the source items the
		-- picker was opened for) so Set can't accidentally write self-as-target.
		local excludeSet = {}
		if opts.excludeItems then
			for _, ex in ipairs(opts.excludeItems) do excludeSet[ex] = true end
		end
		local function refreshFromSelection()
			local sel = Selection:Get()
			local picked = sel and sel[1] or nil
			-- Skip self-as-target: clear the line so the user has to consciously pick a
			-- different instance instead of accidentally committing self.
			if picked and excludeSet[picked] then picked = nil end
			_selected = picked
			if picked then _selectedCache = picked end
			instanceLine.Text = _selected and ("Instance: " .. _selected:GetFullName())
				or (_selectedCache and ("Instance: " .. _selectedCache:GetFullName() .. " (cached)"))
				or "Instance: <nil>"
		end
		refreshFromSelection()
		-- Register through ConnectionManager so plugin teardown disconnects this
		-- listener even if the picker close path never fires (e.g. plugin disabled
		-- mid-pick). The local `conn` still handles the normal Set/Cancel close.
		local conn = Selection.SelectionChanged:Connect(refreshFromSelection)
		if deps.Connections then deps.Connections["ConfigPanelInstancePicker"] = conn end

		-- 200ms poll: catches Selection states that never fire SelectionChanged during
		-- this picker's lifetime (e.g. Roblox Deferred signal dropping events under load).
		-- Loop exits when panel is destroyed (panel.Parent == nil).
		local _alive = true
		task.spawn(function()
			while _alive do
				task.wait(0.2)
				if not _alive then return end
				local sel = Selection:Get()
				local picked = sel and sel[1] or nil
				if picked and excludeSet[picked] then picked = nil end
				if picked then _selectedCache = picked end
			end
		end)

		local function close(commit)
			_alive = false
			if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn = nil end
			panel:Destroy()
			if _activePanel and _activePanel.frame == panel then _activePanel = nil end
			-- Commit prefers live Selection; falls back to cache so a Set click that races
			-- with Studio clearing Selection still writes the user's most-recent pick.
			local commitTarget = _selected or _selectedCache
			if commit and opts.onSet then opts.onSet(commitTarget) end
			if not commit and opts.onCancel then opts.onCancel() end
		end

		-- Snapshot Selection on MouseDown  -  fires BEFORE Studio's focus-shift cascade
		-- clears Selection on plugin-GUI click. By the time Activated (MouseUp) fires,
		-- Selection is reported empty. MouseDown runs while Studio Selection still
		-- holds the pick. Mirrored on the panel background so a mouse-down anywhere
		-- in the picker captures the live pick, not just the Set button.
		local function snapshotSelectionNow()
			local sel = Selection:Get()
			local picked = sel and sel[1] or nil
			if picked and excludeSet[picked] then picked = nil end
			if picked then
				_selectedCache = picked
				_selected = picked
				instanceLine.Text = "Instance: " .. picked:GetFullName()
			end
		end
		setBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(snapshotSelectionNow)
		panel.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then snapshotSelectionNow() end
		end)

		-- Run opts.validate(picked) BEFORE closing. When validation rejects, the
		-- panel stays open + the prompt label flashes a hint so the user knows
		-- their pick was wrong instead of seeing the panel vanish silently.
		setBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			-- Force a Selection re-read at click time. Deferred SignalBehavior can let the
			-- Set button fire before our SelectionChanged listener runs, leaving _selected
			-- stale (or pinned to a previous pick like the parent Frame of a CanvasGroup).
			refreshFromSelection()
			-- Live Selection beats cache; cache covers the case where clicking Set itself
			-- caused Studio to report empty Selection (the 0.2s poll captured the last
			-- valid pick before that).
			local target = _selected or _selectedCache
			if not target then
				instanceLine.Text = "No instance selected  -  click one in Studio first"
				instanceLine.TextColor3 = T.Red or Color3.fromRGB(220, 80, 80)
				return
			end
			if opts.validate then
				local okValid, msg = opts.validate(target)
				if not okValid then
					instanceLine.Text = msg or "Invalid selection  -  pick a different instance"
					instanceLine.TextColor3 = T.Red or Color3.fromRGB(220, 80, 80)
					return
				end
			end
			_selected = target
			close(true)
		end)
		cancelBtn.Activated:Connect(function() close(false) end)
		if clearBtn then
			clearBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
				if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn = nil end
				panel:Destroy()
				if _activePanel and _activePanel.frame == panel then _activePanel = nil end
				if opts.onClear then opts.onClear() end
			end)
		end

		_activePanel = { frame = panel, close = function() close(false) end }
		return _activePanel
	end

	-- Axis-link picker. opts.axes is a list of full property keys (e.g. {"SizeX","SizeY","SizeZ"}).
	-- opts.current is a table { [axisKey] = primaryKey or nil } reflecting current LinkedTo state.
	-- Set callback receives a linkMap of the same shape (primary axis maps to nil).
	local function openAxisLinkPanel(opts)
		closeActive()
		local screenGui = W.getScreenGui and W.getScreenGui() or deps.screenGui
		if not screenGui then Log.warn("[Part-Icles] ConfigPanel: missing ScreenGui"); return end
		local axes = opts.axes or {}
		if #axes == 0 then return end

		local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
		panel.Name = "ConfigPanel_AxisLink"
		panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 158)
		panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
		panel.BorderSizePixel = 0; panel.ZIndex = 200; panel.Active = true
		panel:SetAttribute("_opaquePanel", true); panel:SetAttribute("_noSnap", true)
		panel.Parent = screenGui
		W.addCorner(panel, T.Corner); W.addStroke(panel); W.addPadding(panel, 8, 8, 8, 8)

		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel"); title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Text = opts.title or "Link axes"; title.TextColor3 = T.Gold
		title.Font = T.Font; title.TextSize = 12; title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		title.ZIndex = 201; title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16); title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		title.Parent = panel

		if opts.context and opts.context ~= "" then
			local ctxLine = Instance.new("TextLabel"); ctxLine.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			ctxLine.Text = "for: " .. opts.context; ctxLine.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
			ctxLine.Font = T.Font; ctxLine.TextSize = 10; ctxLine.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			ctxLine.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd; ctxLine.ZIndex = 201
			ctxLine.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14); ctxLine.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 18)
			ctxLine.Parent = panel
		end

		-- Build axis-set for sanitizing incoming current state.
		local axisSet = {}
		for _, a in ipairs(axes) do axisSet[a] = true end
		-- Sanitize: drop self-links and any LinkedTo value not in this row's axes list.
		-- Stale or hand-edited bad attrs can otherwise round-trip forever.
		local linkMap = {}
		for _, a in ipairs(axes) do
			local v = opts.current and opts.current[a] or nil
			if v == a or (v ~= nil and not axisSet[v]) then v = nil end
			linkMap[a] = v
		end
		local primary
		for _, a in ipairs(axes) do
			if linkMap[a] == nil then
				local hasFollower = false
				for _, b in ipairs(axes) do if b ~= a and linkMap[b] == a then hasFollower = true; break end end
				if hasFollower then primary = a; break end
			end
		end
		if not primary then primary = axes[1] end
		-- Strip self-links from initial state.
		if linkMap[primary] then linkMap[primary] = nil end

		local prompt = Instance.new("TextLabel"); prompt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		prompt.Text = "Primary axis (others can link to it):"; prompt.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
		prompt.Font = T.Font; prompt.TextSize = 10; prompt.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		prompt.ZIndex = 201; prompt.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14); prompt.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 38)
		prompt.Parent = panel

		local pillW = math.floor((280 - 16 - (#axes - 1) * 4) / #axes)
		local pills = {}
		-- Side table: TextButton Instance -> axisKey. Roblox Instances don't accept arbitrary
		-- custom fields so attaching `b.AxisKey = ...` would silently fail and downstream reads
		-- would index nil.
		local pillAxes = {}
		-- Axes the user actually touched. onSet writes only these so a Set on a
		-- mixed multi-selection doesn't overwrite untouched per-item state.
		local dirtyAxes = {}
		local function refreshPills()
			for _, p in ipairs(pills) do
				local axisKey = pillAxes[p]
				if axisKey == primary then
					p.BackgroundColor3 = T.BrightGold; p.BackgroundTransparency = 0
					p.TextColor3 = T.PanelBg; p.Text = axisKey .. " *"
				elseif linkMap[axisKey] == primary then
					p.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; p.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
					p.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; p.Text = axisKey .. " ->"
				else
					p.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; p.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
					p.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold; p.Text = axisKey
				end
			end
		end
		for i, axisKey in ipairs(axes) do
			local b = Instance.new("TextButton"); b.Name = axisKey .. "Pill"
			b.Font = T.Font; b.TextSize = 11; b.BorderSizePixel = 0; b.ZIndex = 201
			b.Size = UDim2.new(0, pillW, 0, 22)
			b.Position = UDim2.new(0, (i - 1) * (pillW + 4), 0, 56)
			b.Parent = panel; W.addCorner(b, UDim.new(0, 4)); W.addStroke(b)
			pillAxes[b] = axisKey
			pills[#pills + 1] = b
			-- Single InputBegan handler for MouseButton1: shift-held promotes axis to primary
			-- (followers re-anchor to the new primary). Plain click toggles linked-to-primary.
			b.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
				local shift = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
				if shift then
					primary = axisKey; linkMap[axisKey] = nil
					for _, other in ipairs(axes) do
						if other ~= primary and linkMap[other] ~= nil then linkMap[other] = primary end
						dirtyAxes[other] = true
					end
				elseif axisKey ~= primary then
					if linkMap[axisKey] == primary then linkMap[axisKey] = nil
					else linkMap[axisKey] = primary end
					dirtyAxes[axisKey] = true
				end
				refreshPills()
			end)
		end
		refreshPills()

		local primaryHint = Instance.new("TextLabel"); primaryHint.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		primaryHint.Text = "(shift-click an axis to make it primary)"; primaryHint.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
		primaryHint.Font = T.Font; primaryHint.TextSize = 9; primaryHint.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		primaryHint.ZIndex = 201; primaryHint.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12); primaryHint.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 84)
		primaryHint.Parent = panel

		local function makeBtn(text, x)
			local b = Instance.new("TextButton"); b.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; b.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			b.Text = text; b.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; b.Font = T.Font; b.TextSize = 11
			b.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -3, 0, 22); b.Position = UDim2.new(x, x == 0 and 0 or 3, 1, -22)
			b.BorderSizePixel = 0; b.ZIndex = 201; b.Parent = panel
			W.addCorner(b, UDim.new(0, 4)); W.addStroke(b); return b
		end
		local setBtn = makeBtn("Set", 0); local cancelBtn = makeBtn("Cancel", 0.5)

		local function close(commit)
			panel:Destroy()
			if _activePanel and _activePanel.frame == panel then _activePanel = nil end
			if commit and opts.onSet then opts.onSet(linkMap, dirtyAxes) end
			if not commit and opts.onCancel then opts.onCancel() end
		end
		setBtn.Activated:Connect(function() close(true) end)
		cancelBtn.Activated:Connect(function() close(false) end)
		_activePanel = { frame = panel, close = function() close(false) end }
		return _activePanel
	end

	-- One pill per kind: lit = the property acts on that kind. A click flips it.
	local function openApplyPanel(opts)
		closeActive()
		local screenGui = W.getScreenGui and W.getScreenGui() or deps.screenGui
		if not screenGui then
			Log.warn("[Part-Icles] ConfigPanel: missing ScreenGui")
			return
		end
		local kinds = opts.kinds or {}
		if #kinds == 0 then return end

		local PANEL_WIDTH = 280
		local PILL_HEIGHT = 22
		local MOST_PER_ROW = 4
		local pillGap = 4
		-- More kinds than fit one row are split evenly over two.
		local perRow = #kinds
		if perRow > MOST_PER_ROW then
			perRow = math.ceil(#kinds / 2)
		end
		local pillRows = math.ceil(#kinds / perRow)
		local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
		panel.Name = "ConfigPanel_ApplyTo"
		panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg
		panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, PANEL_WIDTH, 0, 122 + (pillRows - 1) * (PILL_HEIGHT + pillGap))
		panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
		panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
		panel.ZIndex = 200
		panel.Active = true
		panel:SetAttribute("_opaquePanel", true)
		panel:SetAttribute("_noSnap", true)
		panel.Parent = screenGui
		W.addCorner(panel, T.Corner)
		W.addStroke(panel)
		W.addPadding(panel, 8, 8, 8, 8)

		local function makeLine(text, color, textSize, top, height)
			local line = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			line.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			line.Text = text
			line.TextColor3 = color
			line.Font = T.Font
			line.TextSize = textSize
			line.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			line.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
			line.ZIndex = 201
			line.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
			line.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, top)
			line.Parent = panel
			return line
		end
		makeLine(opts.title or "Apply to", T.Gold, 12, 0, 16)
		makeLine("for: " .. tostring(opts.context or ""), T.MutedGold, 10, 18, 14)
		makeLine("Lit = this property acts on it. Click to switch.", T.DarkGold, 9, 36, 12)

		local applies = {}
		for _, kind in ipairs(kinds) do
			applies[kind.key] = not (opts.applies and opts.applies[kind.key] == false)
		end

		local pillWidth = math.floor((PANEL_WIDTH - 16 - (perRow - 1) * pillGap) / perRow)
		for index, kind in ipairs(kinds) do
			local column = (index - 1) % perRow
			local row = math.floor((index - 1) / perRow)
			local pill = Instance.new("TextButton")
			pill.Name = kind.key .. "Pill"
			pill.Font = T.Font
			pill.TextSize = 11
			pill.Text = kind.label
			pill.BorderSizePixel = 0
			pill.ZIndex = 201
			pill.Size = UDim2.new(0, pillWidth, 0, PILL_HEIGHT)
			pill.Position = UDim2.new(0, column * (pillWidth + pillGap), 0, 54 + row * (PILL_HEIGHT + pillGap))
			pill.Parent = panel
			W.addCorner(pill, UDim.new(0, 4))
			W.addStroke(pill)
			local function paint()
				if applies[kind.key] then
					pill.BackgroundColor3 = T.BrightGold
					pill.BackgroundTransparency = 0
					pill.TextColor3 = T.PanelBg
				else
					pill.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
					pill.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
					pill.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
				end
			end
			paint()
			pill.Activated:Connect(function()
				applies[kind.key] = not applies[kind.key]
				paint()
			end)
		end

		local function makeButton(text, scaleX)
			local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
			button.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
			button.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			button.Text = text
			button.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
			button.Font = T.Font
			button.TextSize = 11
			button.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -3, 0, 22)
			button.Position = UDim2.new(scaleX, scaleX == 0 and 0 or 3, 1, -22)
			button.BorderSizePixel = 0
			button.ZIndex = 201
			button.Parent = panel
			W.addCorner(button, UDim.new(0, 4))
			W.addStroke(button)
			return button
		end
		local setButton = makeButton("Set", 0)
		local cancelButton = makeButton("Cancel", 0.5)

		local function close(commit)
			panel:Destroy()
			if _activePanel and _activePanel.frame == panel then _activePanel = nil end
			if commit and opts.onSet then opts.onSet(applies) end
			if not commit and opts.onCancel then opts.onCancel() end
		end
		setButton.Activated:Connect(function() close(true) end)
		cancelButton.Activated:Connect(function() close(false) end)
		_activePanel = { frame = panel, close = function() close(false) end }
		return _activePanel
	end

	-- True while either the instance picker OR the axis-link panel is open.
	-- Callers (init.server.lua's SelectionChanged hook) gate handleSelection on
	-- this so a Studio Selection change made WHILE the picker is open doesn't
	-- repopulate the Properties panel out from under the user  -  the picker uses
	-- Selection to read the user's chosen target, but the rest of the plugin
	-- should stay frozen on the source items being configured.
	local function isOpen() return _activePanel ~= nil end

	return {
		openInstancePicker = openInstancePicker,
		openAxisLinkPanel = openAxisLinkPanel,
		openApplyPanel = openApplyPanel,
		closeActive = closeActive,
		isOpen = isOpen,
	}
end

--[[
	UIBuilderConstants  -  Part-Icles V5
	Copyright (C) 2026 Qwinkle
	Theme tokens, layout metrics, fonts, palette and presets.
	This module is a singleton: all consumers share the same T, LAYOUT and MODE tables.

	T holds the saved theme (Input*, TextAccent, Mode, TextSize, Font, BgImage) and every colour
	derived from it. Constants.refresh() recomputes the derived colours and LAYOUT through
	ThemeModes; it runs once at load, before each Build, and on every theme edit.
	Names older panels use are filled from the roles: PanelBg = Panel, BlobBg = Field,
	Border = Outline, BrightGold = TextPrimary, Gold = TextHeading, MutedGold = TextLabel,
	DarkGold = TextSecondary, Green = Success, Red = Danger.
]]

local ThemeModes = require(script.Parent.ThemeModes)

local Constants = {}

	InputPanelAlpha = 0.15, InputBlobAlpha = 0.25,
	AxisX = Color3.fromRGB(238, 136, 136), AxisY = Color3.fromRGB(136, 238, 136), AxisZ = Color3.fromRGB(136, 136, 238),
}

-- Panel geometry that no mode changes. Constants.refresh() adds the active mode's metrics.
Constants.LAYOUT = {
	HudWidth = 164, HudX = 12, HudY = 12,
	PropsWidth = 280, PropsHeight = 520, PropsX = 292, PropsY = 12,
	SettingsWidth = 200, SettingsHeight = 380,
}

-- The UIScale that the settings box calls 100%. 1.25 keeps the 4-offset grid on whole pixels.
Constants.BASE_UI_SCALE = 1.25
-- How see-through a solid-panel mode makes its panels while the theme has a background image.
Constants.PANEL_ALPHA_OVER_IMAGE = 0.45
Constants.DEFAULT_UI_SCALE_PERCENT = 100

-- Axis colours before a mode adjusts them for contrast.
Constants.AXIS_BASE = {
	X = Color3.fromRGB(238, 136, 136),
	Y = Color3.fromRGB(136, 238, 136),
	Z = Color3.fromRGB(136, 136, 238),
}

-- Active mode: Id and Structure (see ThemeModes). Widgets read it at build time, so a mode or
-- text-size change needs a rebuild.
Constants.MODE = {}

local BODY_FAMILY = "rbxasset://fonts/families/BuilderSans.json"
local MONO_FAMILY = "rbxasset://fonts/families/BuilderMono.json"
local SOFT_FAMILY = "rbxasset://fonts/families/Nunito.json"

-- Builder Sans at the given weight: rows, labels, buttons.
function Constants.bodyFont(weight)
	return Font.new(BODY_FAMILY, weight or Enum.FontWeight.Medium)
end

-- Builder Mono keeps digits in columns. It ships Light, Regular and Bold only.
function Constants.monoFont(weight)
	return Font.new(MONO_FAMILY, weight or Enum.FontWeight.Regular)
end

-- Nunito, a rounded face, for the short words on chips: soft and heavy without the pull of the
-- theme font. Its weights share one set of letter widths, so text in any of them is measured
-- with SOFT_MEASURE_FONT (TextService:GetTextSize takes an Enum.Font, and only Regular has one).
function Constants.softFont(weight)
	return Font.new(SOFT_FAMILY, weight or Enum.FontWeight.Bold)
end
Constants.SOFT_MEASURE_FONT = Enum.Font.Nunito

-- The theme font at the given weight; a family without that weight draws its nearest one.
function Constants.themeFont(weight)
	local base = Font.fromEnum(Constants.T.Font)
	return Font.new(base.Family, weight or Enum.FontWeight.Regular, base.Style)
end

-- Recompute every derived colour and metric from the saved theme in T.
function Constants.refresh()
	local T = Constants.T
	local LAYOUT = Constants.LAYOUT
	local resolved = ThemeModes.resolve({
		panel = T.InputBg,
		field = T.InputBlob,
		accent = T.InputAccent,
		text = T.TextAccent,
		slider = T.InputSlider,
		scrollBar = T.InputScrollBar,
	}, T.Mode, T.TextSize)

	T.Mode = resolved.Id
	T.TextSize = ThemeModes.textSize(T.TextSize)
	Constants.MODE.Id = resolved.Id
	Constants.MODE.Structure = resolved.Structure

	local surface = resolved.Surface
	T.PanelAlpha = surface.UsesSavedAlpha and T.InputPanelAlpha or surface.PanelAlpha
	-- A mode with solid panels would hide the theme's background image behind them (the image
	-- sits under each panel, Widgets.attachPanelBackground). With an image set, the panels thin
	-- out so it shows inside them; fields stay solid.
	if not surface.UsesSavedAlpha and T.BgImage ~= "" and T.BgImageTransparency < 1 then
		T.PanelAlpha = Constants.PANEL_ALPHA_OVER_IMAGE
	end
	T.BlobAlpha = surface.UsesSavedAlpha and T.InputBlobAlpha or surface.BlobAlpha
	T.BorderAlpha = surface.BorderAlpha

	for role, color in pairs(resolved.Roles) do
		T[role] = color
	end
	T.PanelBg = T.Panel
	T.BlobBg = T.Field
	T.Border = T.Outline
	T.BrightGold = T.TextPrimary
	T.Gold = T.TextHeading
	T.MutedGold = T.TextLabel
	T.DarkGold = T.TextSecondary
	T.Green = T.Success
	T.Red = T.Danger

	-- Axis colours: Classic keeps the originals; the other modes lift each to read clearly on a field.
	local ColorMath = ThemeModes.ColorMath
	local light = ColorMath.isLight(T.Panel)
	for axis, base in pairs(Constants.AXIS_BASE) do
		if resolved.Structure.Classic then
			T["Axis" .. axis] = base
		else
			local _, chroma, hue = ColorMath.toOklch(base)
			T["Axis" .. axis] = ColorMath.oklchWithContrast(light and 0.50 or 0.80, math.min(chroma, 0.14), hue, { T.Field }, 5, light)
		end
	end

	for name, value in pairs(resolved.Metrics) do
		LAYOUT[name] = value
	end
	LAYOUT.RowHeight = LAYOUT.Row
	LAYOUT.SectionHead = LAYOUT.GroupHead
	LAYOUT.ContentOffset = LAYOUT.RowIndent + LAYOUT.LabelWidth + LAYOUT.LabelGap
	T.Corner = UDim.new(0, LAYOUT.Corner)
	T.BigCorner = UDim.new(0, LAYOUT.BigCorner)
end

Constants.refresh()

-- Hex conversion utilities
function Constants.color3ToHex(c)
	return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(c.R*255+0.5), math.floor(c.G*255+0.5), math.floor(c.B*255+0.5))
end

function Constants.hexToColor3(hex)
	hex = hex:gsub("#","")
	if #hex == 3 then hex = hex:sub(1,1):rep(2)..hex:sub(2,2):rep(2)..hex:sub(3,3):rep(2) end
	if #hex ~= 6 then return nil end
	local r, g, b = tonumber(hex:sub(1,2),16), tonumber(hex:sub(3,4),16), tonumber(hex:sub(5,6),16)
	if not r or not g or not b then return nil end
	return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b)
end

--[[
	DeckSplit  -  lets a tool deck come apart into one panel per page, and back.

	DeckSplit.attach(W, deck) builds one hidden panel per page (title "<deck title> <page label>",
	its own close / minimize / resize, and a button that merges the pages back) and adds to
	deck.api:
	  setSplit(on)   on: every page moves into its own panel, the ones the deck was showing open
	                 side by side where the deck was; off: the pages go back into the deck
	  isSplit()
	  solos()        { [pageKey] = panel }
	While split, show(key) / hide() / toggle(key) / setTab(key) act on the page panels (WidgetDeck
	routes them here), a page frame is Visible exactly when its panel is (QOLWiring and
	SelectionHandler read page.Visible), and the deck frame stays hidden. The deck frame's
	attribute Split mirrors the state; Modules/PanelPersistence saves it.

	deck = { sg, frame, chrome, title, pages, pageFrames, heights, width, minWidth, api, getActive,
	         setActive, syncPages }   (all owned by WidgetDeck.makeDeck; chrome is the deck's
	         ToolShell chrome: page frames live in a shell's body)
	A page panel may be dragged as narrow as the deck's pages may (deck.minWidth), but no
	narrower than its header buttons and a few letters of its title.
	Mutates the deck's LIVE page frames: Parent and Visible.
]]

local DeckSplit = {}

-- "Pull apart" on the deck, "put together" on a page panel. The theme fonts carry these glyphs.
local SPLIT_TEXT = "\u{25C0}\u{25B6}"
local MERGE_TEXT = "\u{25B6}\u{25C0}"
local PANEL_GAP = 4
-- Width a page panel's title keeps beside its header buttons at the panel's narrowest.
local TITLE_ROOM = 40

function DeckSplit.attach(W, deck)
	local api = deck.api
	local solos = {}
	local split = false

	for _, page in ipairs(deck.pages) do
		local panel, chrome = W.makeToolShell(deck.sg, deck.frame.Name .. page.key, deck.width, deck.heights[page.key])
		panel.Name = deck.frame.Name .. page.key
		local title = (deck.title and (deck.title .. " ") or "") .. page.label
		panel:SetAttribute("TrayTitle", title)
		chrome.addButton("Split", MERGE_TEXT, function() api.setSplit(false) end)
		chrome.title.Text = title
		chrome.title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(chrome.controlsWidth + 4), 1, 0)
		chrome.title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		local padding = panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding")
		local sidePadding = 0
		if padding then
			sidePadding = padding.PaddingLeft.Offset + padding.PaddingRight.Offset
		end
		W.setResizeMinimum(panel, math.max(deck.minWidth, chrome.controlsWidth + TITLE_ROOM + sidePadding))
		panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
			if split then deck.pageFrames[page.key].Visible = panel.Visible end
		end)
		solos[page.key] = panel
	end

	local function anySoloShowing()
		for _, panel in pairs(solos) do
			if panel.Visible then return true end
		end
		return false
	end

	-- Opens the page panels in `keys` side by side, starting at the deck's place.
	local function openSideBySide(keys)
		local origin = deck.frame.Position
		local offset = 0
		for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
			local panel = solos[key]
			panel.Position = origin + UDim2.fromOffset(offset, 0)
			panel.Visible = true
			offset += panel.Size.X.Offset + PANEL_GAP
			task.defer(function() W.resolveOverlap(panel) end)
		end
	end

	function api.setSplit(on)
		if on == split then return end
		if on then
			local wasShowing = deck.frame.Visible
			split = true
			deck.frame.Visible = false
			for _, page in ipairs(deck.pages) do
				local pageFrame = deck.pageFrames[page.key]
				local panel = solos[page.key]
				panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, deck.frame.Size.X.Offset, 0, deck.heights[page.key])
				pageFrame.Parent = W.toolChrome(panel).body
				pageFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
				pageFrame.Visible = false
			end
			if wasShowing then
				local keys = {}
				for _, page in ipairs(deck.pages) do table.insert(keys, page.key) end
				openSideBySide(keys)
			end
		else
			local reopen = anySoloShowing()
			local first = nil
			for _, page in ipairs(deck.pages) do
				local panel = solos[page.key]
				if panel.Visible and not first then first = page.key end
				deck.heights[page.key] = panel.Size.Y.Offset
				panel.Visible = false
				deck.pageFrames[page.key].Parent = deck.chrome.body
			end
			split = false
			if first then deck.setActive(first) end
			deck.syncPages()
			if reopen then api.show() end
		end
		deck.frame:SetAttribute("Split", split)
	end

	function api.isSplit()
		return split
	end

	function api.solos()
		return solos
	end

	-- Split-mode versions of the deck calls; WidgetDeck asks `handles(key)` first.
	local routed = {}
	function routed.show(key)
		if key and solos[key] then
			W.restoreChip(solos[key])
			solos[key].Visible = true
			deck.setActive(key)
			task.defer(function() W.resolveOverlap(solos[key]) end)
			return
		end
		local keys = {}
		for _, page in ipairs(deck.pages) do table.insert(keys, page.key) end
		openSideBySide(keys)
	end
	function routed.hide()
		for _, panel in pairs(solos) do panel.Visible = false end
	end
	function routed.toggle(key)
		if key and solos[key] then
			if solos[key].Visible then solos[key].Visible = false else routed.show(key) end
			return
		end
		if anySoloShowing() then routed.hide() else routed.show() end
	end
	function routed.setTab(key)
		if solos[key] then deck.setActive(key) end
	end

	-- A path that shows the deck itself while split (a stale tray chip) opens the page panels.
	deck.frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if split and deck.frame.Visible then
			deck.frame.Visible = false
			routed.show()
		end
	end)

	deck.chrome.addButton("Split", SPLIT_TEXT, function() api.setSplit(true) end)
	deck.frame:SetAttribute("Split", false)
	return {
		isSplit = function() return split end,
		routed = routed,
		solos = solos,
	}
end

return DeckSplit

--[[
	HitFilterPanel  -  modal for the type-level Hit Filter row (Modules/Part/HitFilter). Two controls:

	  1. Collision Group dropdown  -  RaycastParams.CollisionGroup string. Sourced from
	     PhysicsService:GetRegisteredCollisionGroups() with "(none)" as the unset option.
	  2. Exclude List  -  multi-instance picker. RaycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances ignores
	     each listed Instance + all descendants.

	OnHit, Rocks and Lightning Seek raycasts all read the same filter. Writes go to EVERY item in
	opts.items; one undo step per open/close session. Reuses ConfigPanel.openInstancePicker for Add.

	Returns: { open(opts), close(), isOpen() }
	opts: { items = {...}, onClose = function? }
]]

local Log = require(script.Parent.Parent.Part.Log)

local PhysicsService = game:GetService("PhysicsService")

return function(deps)
	local W = deps.W
	local T = deps.T
	local ConfigPanel = deps.ConfigPanel
	local EventsSchema = deps.EventsSchema
	local HitFilter = deps.HitFilter
	local ChangeHistoryService = deps.ChangeHistoryService

	local _activePanel = nil
	-- True while an open modal session is collecting writes. closeActive emits the
	-- closing waypoint only when this is true; teardown calls (no session) skip it.
	local _sessionActive = false
	-- Fired once on closeActive when a session is open, so the Events panel's Hit Filter
	-- label refreshes without the user re-selecting the items.
	local _onCloseCallback = nil

	local function closeActive()
		local fireCallback = _sessionActive and _onCloseCallback
		if _sessionActive then
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Hit Filter")
			_sessionActive = false
		end
		_onCloseCallback = nil
		if _activePanel then
			pcall(function() _activePanel:Destroy() end)
			_activePanel = nil
		end
		if fireCallback then pcall(fireCallback) end
	end

	-- Registered group names with "(none)" prepended. PhysicsService returns {{id, name, mask}, ...}.
	local function collectGroupNames()
		local out = { "(none)" }
		local ok, groups = pcall(function() return PhysicsService:GetRegisteredCollisionGroups() end)
		if ok and type(groups) == "table" then
			for _, g in ipairs(groups) do
				if type(g) == "table" and type(g.name) == "string" then
					table.insert(out, g.name)
				end
			end
		end
		return out
	end

	-- Union of every selected item's excludes, deduped.
	local function gatherExcludes(items)
		local seen = {}
		local list = {}
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do
			local _, excludes = HitFilter.read(item)
			for _, inst in ipairs(excludes) do
				if not seen[inst] then
					seen[inst] = true
					table.insert(list, inst)
				end
			end
		end
		return list
	end

	-- Mutators run inside an open modal session; the open/close waypoints bracket them into one undo step.
	local function addExcludeToAll(items, inst)
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do HitFilter.addExclude(item, inst) end
	end

	local function removeExcludeFromAll(items, inst)
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do HitFilter.removeExclude(item, inst) end
	end

	local function setGroupOnAll(items, groupName)
		local value = (groupName == "(none)") and "" or groupName
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do HitFilter.setGroup(item, value) end
	end

	-- nil = mixed, "" = none, else the shared group name.
	local function commonGroup(items)
		local first, set = nil, false
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do
			local v = HitFilter.read(item)
			if not set then first = v; set = true
			elseif v ~= first then return nil end
		end
		return first
	end

	local function open(opts)
		closeActive()
		if not opts or not opts.items or #opts.items == 0 then return end

		-- Only raycasting types carry a filter; surface the mismatch instead of opening a dead modal.
		local originalCount = #opts.items
		local filteredItems = {}
		for _, item in ipairs(opts.items) do
			if EventsSchema.isValidForItem(item, "OnHit") then
				table.insert(filteredItems, item)
			end
		end
		if #filteredItems == 0 then
			Log.print("[Part-Icles] Hit Filter not applicable to this selection  -  Beam / PointLight / Trail / screens do not raycast.")
			return
		end
		opts.items = filteredItems

		local screenGui = W.getScreenGui and W.getScreenGui() or deps.screenGui
		if not screenGui then return end

		-- Open the undo session BEFORE creating any UI. Waypoints inside the modal
		-- collapse into one undo step bracketed by this + closeActive's waypoint.
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Hit Filter")
		_sessionActive = true
		_onCloseCallback = opts.onClose
		-- Legacy per-event filters move to the type level inside the same undo step.
		for _, item in ipairs(filteredItems) do HitFilter.migrateFromEvent(item) end

		local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
		panel.Name = "HitFilterPanel"
		panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg
		-- T.PanelAlpha matches the main settings panel so the parchment ImageLabel
		-- (attached as a sibling at ZIndex 0 via attachPanelBackground) renders
		-- through the panel's solid color instead of being fully occluded.
		panel.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
		panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 280)
		panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
		panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
		panel.ZIndex = 200
		panel.Active = true
		panel:SetAttribute("_opaquePanel", true)
		panel:SetAttribute("_noSnap", true)
		panel.Parent = screenGui
		W.addCorner(panel, T.Corner)
		W.addStroke(panel)
		W.addPadding(panel, 8, 8, 8, 8)
		W.attachPanelBackground(panel)
		_activePanel = panel

		-- Header
		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Text = "Hit Filter"
		title.TextColor3 = T.Gold
		title.Font = T.Font
		title.TextSize = 12
		title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		title.ZIndex = 201
		title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16)
		title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		title.Parent = panel

		-- Drag handle covers the title bar minus the close X. ZIndex 201 keeps it
		-- above the panel's image overlay but below the close button (ZIndex 202).
		local dragHandle = Instance.new("TextButton")
		dragHandle.Name = "DragHandle"
		dragHandle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		dragHandle.Text = ""
		dragHandle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16)
		dragHandle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		dragHandle.ZIndex = 201
		dragHandle.Parent = panel
		W.makeDraggable(panel, dragHandle)

		local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
		closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		closeBtn.Text = "X"
		closeBtn.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
		closeBtn.Font = T.Font
		closeBtn.TextSize = 12
		closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
		closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 0)
		closeBtn.ZIndex = 202
		closeBtn.Parent = panel

		-- "Applies to N of M" notice when the selection includes items without a filter.
		if #filteredItems < originalCount then
			local notice = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			notice.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			notice.Text = ("Filter applies to %d of %d selected items"):format(#filteredItems, originalCount)
			notice.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
			notice.Font = T.Font
			notice.TextSize = 9
			notice.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			notice.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
			notice.ZIndex = 201
			notice.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12)
			notice.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 18)
			notice.Parent = panel
		end

		-- Collision group row
		local cgLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		cgLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		cgLbl.Text = "Collision Group"
		cgLbl.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
		cgLbl.Font = T.Font
		cgLbl.TextSize = 10
		cgLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		cgLbl.ZIndex = 201
		cgLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 22)
		cgLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 22)
		cgLbl.Parent = panel

		local cgWrap = Instance.new("Frame")
		cgWrap.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		cgWrap.Size = UDim2.new(1, -104, 0, 22)
		cgWrap.Position = UDim2.new(0, 104, 0, 22)
		cgWrap.ZIndex = 201
		cgWrap.Parent = panel

		local groupNames = collectGroupNames()
		local currentGroup = commonGroup(opts.items)
		local defaultText
		if currentGroup == nil then defaultText = "~"
		elseif currentGroup == "" then defaultText = "(none)"
		else defaultText = currentGroup end
		local cgLblWidget, cgFrame, cgSetOnChanged = W.makeDropdown("CGroup", cgWrap, groupNames, defaultText)
		cgFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		cgFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		-- Mixed selection shows "~" over the dropdown's options[1] default.
		if currentGroup == nil then cgLblWidget.Text = "~" end
		cgSetOnChanged(function(picked)
			setGroupOnAll(opts.items, picked)
		end)

		-- Exclude List header
		local exHdr = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		exHdr.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		exHdr.Text = "Exclude List (ignores instance + descendants)"
		exHdr.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
		exHdr.Font = T.Font
		exHdr.TextSize = 10
		exHdr.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		exHdr.ZIndex = 201
		exHdr.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
		exHdr.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 52)
		exHdr.Parent = panel

		-- Scroll body for the list
		local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
		scroll.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
		scroll.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
		scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
		scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 160)
		scroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 70)
		scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 6
		scroll.ZIndex = 201
		scroll.Parent = panel
		W.addCorner(scroll, UDim.new(0, 4))
		W.addPadding(scroll, 4, 4, 4, 4)
		local listLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
		listLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
		listLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)
		listLayout.Parent = scroll

		local function renderList()
			for _, child in ipairs(scroll:GetChildren()) do
				if not child:IsA("UIListLayout") and not child:IsA("UIPadding") then
					child:Destroy()
				end
			end
			local excludes = gatherExcludes(opts.items)
			if #excludes == 0 then
				local empty = Instance.new("TextLabel")
				empty.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				empty.Text = "(no excludes)"
				empty.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
				empty.Font = T.Font

				empty.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
				empty.LayoutOrder = 0

				empty.Parent = scroll
				return

			for i, inst in ipairs(excludes) do
				local row = Instance.new("Frame")
				row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
				row.LayoutOrder = i
				row.ZIndex = 202

				pathLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, 0)
				pathLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
				pathLbl.ZIndex = 203
				pathLbl.Parent = row

				local rmBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")

	retry.Visible = false
	refs.InvRetryBtn = retry
	return grid
end

-- Name of the tile under the cursor. A child of the panel itself: Grid.luau places it from the
-- panel's corner.
local function buildTooltip(panel, refs)
	local tooltip = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	tooltip.Name = "Tooltip"
	tooltip.BorderSizePixel = 0
	tooltip.Text = ""
	tooltip.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
	tooltip.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, TOOLTIP_HEIGHT)
	tooltip.ZIndex = 25
	tooltip.Visible = false
	TypeScale.style(tooltip, "Caption")
	W.paint(tooltip, "BackgroundColor3", "Field")
	W.paint(tooltip, "TextColor3", "TextPrimary")
	tooltip.Parent = panel
	W.addCorner(tooltip, UDim.new(0, 4))
	W.addStroke(tooltip)
	W.addPadding(tooltip, 6, 6, 0, 0)
	local limit = Instance.new("UISizeConstraint")
	limit.MaxSize = Vector2.new(280, TOOLTIP_HEIGHT)
	limit.Parent = tooltip
	refs.InvTooltip = tooltip
