local function buildModern(screenGui)
	local metrics = Metrics.get()
	local pad = LAYOUT.PanelPad
	local slot = LAYOUT.IconSlot
	local refs = {}
	local skin = Skin.new(metrics)
	refs.InvSkin = skin

	-- Wide and tall enough for Columns x Rows tiles: a tile's gap to its right neighbour covers
	-- the ring room and the scrollbar of the last column.
	local cell = metrics.Tile + metrics.TileGap + metrics.TileName
	local width = metrics.Columns * (metrics.Tile + metrics.TileGap) + pad * 2
	local gridTop = LAYOUT.TitleBar + metrics.TabRow + GAP
	local height = gridTop + metrics.Rows * cell + GAP + LAYOUT.Search + pad * 2

	local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
	panel.Name = "InventoryPanel"
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg
	panel.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
	panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
	panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -width / 2, 0.08, 0)
	panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, height)
	panel.ClipsDescendants = true
	panel.Active = true
	panel.Visible = false
	panel.Parent = screenGui
	W.addCorner(panel, T.BigCorner)
	W.addStroke(panel)
	table.insert(W.getThemed().panels, panel)
	W.attachPanelBackground(panel)
	W.makeResizable(panel, metrics.MinWidth, metrics.MinHeight)
	-- Its grid scrolls, so it gives way to a panel opened over it (PanelPush).
	W.allowPush(panel, metrics.MinWidth, metrics.MinHeight)
	refs.InventoryPanel = panel
	refs.InvHome = panel.Position

	-- Whole-panel scale, set by the Size slider of the title bar's menu.
	local panelScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	panelScale.Name = "PanelScale"
	panelScale.Parent = panel
	refs.InvScale = panelScale

	-- Everything but the tooltip and the dialogs sits inside the panel padding. The panel has no
	-- UIPadding of its own, so what the wiring places from the panel's corner needs no offset.
	local content = Instance.new("Frame")
	content.Name = "Content"
	content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	content.Position = UDim2.new(0, pad, 0, pad)
	content.Size = UDim2.new(1, -pad * 2, 1, -pad * 2)
	content.Parent = panel

	local bar = W.makeTitleBar(content, "Inventory", 0)
	bar.title.Size = UDim2.new(0, metrics.Title, 1, 0)
	-- Its menu drops over the tabs and the grid.
	bar.header.Parent.ZIndex = 10
	refs.InventoryClose = bar.close
	W.makeDraggable(panel, bar.dragHandle)
	local closeMore = buildMoreMenu(bar, refs, metrics)

	-- Two segmented strips Skin.buildLists fills: the Library / Local switch and the list tabs.
	local groupSwitch = W.makeSegmentStrip(bar.header, "Groups")
	groupSwitch.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
	groupSwitch.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
	groupSwitch.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(slot * 2 + GAP), 0.5, 0)
	groupSwitch.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, LAYOUT.TitleBar - 8)
	groupSwitch.ZIndex = 3

	local listTabs = W.makeSegmentStrip(content, "Lists")
	listTabs.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, LAYOUT.TitleBar)
	listTabs.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, metrics.TabRow)
	skin.setListHosts(groupSwitch, listTabs)

	local grid = buildGrid(content, refs, gridTop)
	buildTooltip(panel, refs)
	local _, setTabsShown, closeAdd = BottomRow.build(content, refs, metrics, skin)
	local selection = Bars.buildSelection(content, metrics)
	skin.selection = selection
	local detail = Bars.buildDetail(content, refs, metrics)

	-- From the bottom up: the bottom row, the details card, the multi-select strip; the grid
	-- takes what is left.
	local function layoutBody()
		local docked = LAYOUT.Search + GAP
		detail.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -docked)
		if detail.Visible then
			docked += Bars.detailHeight(metrics) + GAP
		end
		selection.frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -docked)
		if selection.frame.Visible then
			docked += Bars.selectionHeight() + GAP
		end
		grid.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -(gridTop + docked))
	end
	selection.frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(layoutBody)
	detail:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(layoutBody)
	layoutBody()

	function skin.layout(showTabs)
		setTabsShown(showTabs)
	end

	panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if not panel.Visible then
			closeMore()
			closeAdd()
		end
	end)

	InventoryPanel.buildDialogs(screenGui, panel, refs)
	return refs
end

function InventoryLayout.build(screenGui)
	if C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
		return InventoryPanel.build(screenGui)
	end
	return buildModern(screenGui)
end

return InventoryLayout

--[[
	InventoryLayout/Bars  -  what docks between the grid and the bottom row of the Inventory in the
	theme modes other than Classic.
	  Bars.buildSelection(content, metrics) -> widgets   the multi-select strip: a count and its actions.
	      { frame, countLbl, editBtn, edit, exportBtn, dissectBtn, deleteBtn, clearBtn }; InventorySelect
	      wires the buttons and shows the strip while tiles are selected. edit: the parts of the
	      Edit button's menu (EditMenu.build).
	  Bars.selectionHeight() -> height of that strip
	  Bars.buildDetail(content, refs, metrics) -> card   details of the selected tile: preview, name
	      and the facts, then one line of actions ending in Insert. Same ref names as the Classic
	      details panel, so the detail modules of InventoryWiring fill and show it unchanged.
	  Bars.detailHeight(metrics) -> height of that card
	InventoryLayout stacks them and shortens the grid by what is showing.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Parent.Widgets)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.Parent.TypeScale)
local EditMenu = require(script.Parent.EditMenu)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

-- Padding inside the details card, also the gap between its two parts.
local DETAIL_PAD = 8
local COLUMN_GAP = 12
local ACTION_GAP = 4
-- Extra height of the name line over a fact line, and the air under it.
local NAME_EXTRA = 4
local NAME_GAP = 2
local EDIT_ICON = 16

-- Air between the strip's top rule and its buttons.
local STRIP_TOP = 8

local Bars = {}

function Bars.selectionHeight()
	return LAYOUT.Row + STRIP_TOP
end

function Bars.buildSelection(content, metrics)
	local strip = Instance.new("Frame")
	strip.Name = "SelActions"
	strip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	strip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	strip.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
	strip.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, Bars.selectionHeight())
	-- Its Edit menu opens upward over the grid; the bottom row's menus (ZIndex 10) open over it.
	strip.ZIndex = 5
	strip.Visible = false
	strip.Parent = content

	local rule = Instance.new("Frame")
	rule.Name = "Rule"
	rule.BorderSizePixel = 0
	rule.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1)
	W.paint(rule, "BackgroundColor3", "Divider")
	rule.Parent = strip

	-- The count takes the width the buttons leave.
	local row = Instance.new("Frame")
	row.Name = "Row"
	row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	row.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, STRIP_TOP)
	row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row)
	row.Parent = strip
	W.addListLayout(row, 4, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)

	local count = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	count.Name = "SelCount"
	count.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	count.Text = ""
	count.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	count.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	count.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 1, 0)
	count.LayoutOrder = 0
	TypeScale.style(count, "Group")
	W.paint(count, "TextColor3", "TextPrimary")
	count.Parent = row
	local flex = Instance.new("UIFlexItem")
	flex.FlexMode = Enum.UIFlexMode.Fill
	flex.Parent = count

	local editBtn = W.makeTextButton(row, "SelEdit", "Edit", 1)
	return {
		frame = strip,
		countLbl = count,
		editBtn = editBtn,
		edit = EditMenu.build(editBtn, strip, metrics.MoreMenu, true),
		exportBtn = W.makeTextButton(row, "SelExport", "Export", 2),
		dissectBtn = W.makeTextButton(row, "SelDissect", "Dissect", 3),
		deleteBtn = W.makeTextButton(row, "SelDelete", "Delete", 4, "Red"),
		clearBtn = W.makeTextButton(row, "SelClear", "Clear", 5, "TextSecondary"),
	}
end

function Bars.detailHeight(metrics)
	return metrics.Preview + metrics.ActionRow + DETAIL_PAD * 3
end

-- One "label  value" line of the facts list. valueClass is TextLabel, or TextBox for text the
-- user selects or edits; rightInset keeps room for a control at the line's end.
local function makeFact(facts, metrics, order, labelText, valueClass, rightInset)
	local row = Instance.new("Frame")
	row.Name = labelText .. "Row"
	row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, metrics.FactRow)
	row.LayoutOrder = order
	row.Parent = facts

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "Label"
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = labelText
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	label.Size = UDim2.new(0, metrics.FactLabel, 0, metrics.FactRow)
	TypeScale.style(label, "Label")
	W.paint(label, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
	label.Parent = row

	local value = Instance.new(valueClass)
	value.Name = "Value"
	value.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	value.BorderSizePixel = 0
	value.Text = ""
	value.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	value.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	value.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	value.Position = UDim2.new(0, metrics.FactLabel, 0, 0)
	value.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(metrics.FactLabel + rightInset), 1, 0)
	TypeScale.style(value, "Value")
	W.paint(value, "TextColor3", "TextLabel")
	if valueClass == "TextBox" then
		value.TextEditable = false
		value.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	end
	value.Parent = row
	return value, label, row
end

-- Preview of the selected tile: its image, or the 3D view InventoryWiring fills for assets and
-- mesh frames, on the same dark backing as a tile.
local function buildPreview(inner, refs, metrics)
	local size = metrics.Preview
	local corner = UDim.new(0, metrics.TileCorner)

	local slot = Instance.new("Frame")
	slot.Name = "PreviewSlot"
	slot.BorderSizePixel = 0
	slot.Size = UDim2.new(0, size, 0, size)
	W.paint(slot, "BackgroundColor3", "Sunken")
	slot.Parent = inner
	W.addCorner(slot, corner)
	W.addStroke(slot)

	local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	image.Name = "Preview"
	image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	image.BorderSizePixel = 0
	image.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	image.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
	image.Parent = slot
	W.addCorner(image, corner)
	refs.InvDetailPreview = image

	local viewport = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
	viewport.Name = "AssetViewport"
	viewport.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	viewport.BorderSizePixel = 0
	viewport.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	viewport.Ambient = Color3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
	viewport.LightColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	viewport.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-1, -1, -1)
	viewport.Visible = false
	viewport.Parent = slot
	W.addCorner(viewport, corner)
	refs.InvAssetViewport = viewport
end

-- Name on top (a text box: local entries are renamed in place), then the facts. The detail
-- modules of InventoryWiring relabel the ID and Keywords lines per entry type.
local function buildFacts(inner, refs, metrics)
	local left = metrics.Preview + COLUMN_GAP
	local nameHeight = metrics.FactRow + NAME_EXTRA
	local closeRoom = LAYOUT.IconSlot + 4

	local column = Instance.new("Frame")
	column.Name = "Facts"
	column.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	column.Position = UDim2.new(0, left, 0, 0)
	column.Size = UDim2.new(1, -left, 0, metrics.Preview)
	column.Parent = inner

	local name = Instance.new("TextBox")
	name.Name = "Name"
	name.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	name.BorderSizePixel = 0
	name.Text = ""
	name.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	name.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	name.TextEditable = false
	name.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	name.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(EDIT_ICON + 4 + closeRoom), 0, nameHeight)
	TypeScale.style(name, "Group")
	W.paint(name, "TextColor3", "TextPrimary")
	name.Parent = column
	refs.InvDetailName = name

	local editIcon = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	editIcon.Name = "EditIcon"
	editIcon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	editIcon.Text = "\u{270F}"
	editIcon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	editIcon.Position = UDim2.new(1, -closeRoom, 0, 0)
	editIcon.Size = UDim2.new(0, EDIT_ICON, 0, nameHeight)
	editIcon.Visible = false
	TypeScale.style(editIcon, "Caption")
	W.paint(editIcon, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
	editIcon.Parent = column
	refs.InvDetailEditIcon = editIcon

	local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
	close.Name = "DetailClose"
	close.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	close.Text = "\u{00D7}"
	close.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	close.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	close.Size = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.IconSlot, 0, nameHeight)
	TypeScale.style(close, "Glyph")
	W.paint(close, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
	close.Parent = column
	refs.InvDetailClose = close

	local facts = Instance.new("Frame")
	facts.Name = "List"
	facts.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	facts.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, nameHeight + NAME_GAP)
	facts.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -(nameHeight + NAME_GAP))
	facts.Parent = column
	W.addListLayout(facts, 0)

	local idRow
	refs.InvDetailID, refs.InvDetailIDLabel, idRow = makeFact(facts, metrics, 1, "ID", "TextBox", metrics.Copy + 4)
	local copy = W.makeActionButton(idRow, "CopyID", "Copy", 0)
	copy.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	copy.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	copy.Size = UDim2.new(0, metrics.Copy, 1, 0)
	TypeScale.style(copy, "Caption")
	refs.InvCopyIdBtn = copy

	refs.InvDetailInfo = makeFact(facts, metrics, 2, "Info", "TextLabel", 0)
	local gridRow
	refs.InvDetailGrid, refs.InvDetailGridLabel, gridRow = makeFact(facts, metrics, 3, "Grid", "TextBox", 0)
	refs.InvDetailGrid.PlaceholderText = "e.g. 8 for 8x8"
	refs.InvDetailGrid.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold

	-- Keywords come last. Only textures have a grid; when the wiring hides that line, this one
	-- (an asset's path can be long) wraps onto the room it leaves.
	local keywordsRow
	refs.InvDetailKeywords, refs.InvDetailKeywordsLabel, keywordsRow = makeFact(facts, metrics, 4, "Keywords", "TextLabel", 0)
	refs.InvDetailKeywords.TextWrapped = true
	local function fitKeywords()
		local gridShown = refs.InvDetailGrid.Visible
		gridRow.Visible = gridShown
		keywordsRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, metrics.FactRow * (gridShown and 1 or 2))
	end
	refs.InvDetailGrid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(fitKeywords)
	fitKeywords()
end

-- One line under the preview: Favourite, then Trust Asset and Delete when the wiring shows them,
-- and Insert taking the rest of the width as the largest control.
local function buildActions(inner, refs, metrics)
	local row = Instance.new("Frame")
	row.Name = "Actions"
	row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	row.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	row.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
	row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, metrics.ActionRow)
	row.Parent = inner
	W.addListLayout(row, ACTION_GAP, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)

	-- A fixed width: its text changes between Favourite and Favourited! and Insert should not move.
	refs.InvFavBtn = W.makeActionButton(row, "Favourite", "Favourite", 1, "TextLabel")
	refs.InvFavBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, metrics.Favourite, 1, 0)
	refs.InvTrustBtn = W.makeTextButton(row, "TrustAsset", "Trust Asset", 2, "TextHeading")
	refs.InvTrustBtn.Visible = false
	refs.InvDeleteBtn = W.makeTextButton(row, "Delete", "Delete", 3, "Red")
	refs.InvDeleteBtn.Visible = false

	local insert = Instance.new("TextButton")
	insert.Name = "Insert"
	insert.BorderSizePixel = 0
	insert.Text = "Insert"
	insert.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 1, 0)
	insert.LayoutOrder = 4
	TypeScale.style(insert, "Group")
	W.paint(insert, "BackgroundColor3", "Green")
	insert.Parent = row
	W.addCorner(insert)
	local flex = Instance.new("UIFlexItem")
	flex.FlexMode = Enum.UIFlexMode.Fill
	flex.Parent = insert
	refs.InvInsertBtn = insert

	-- Dark text on a light green, white on a dark one.
	local function paintInsertText()
		local green = T.Green
		local brightness = green.R * 0.299 + green.G * 0.587 + green.B * 0.114
		insert.TextColor3 = brightness > 0.45 and Color3.fromRGB(18, 24, 10) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	end
	paintInsertText()
	table.insert(W.getThemed().repaints, paintInsertText)
end

function Bars.buildDetail(content, refs, metrics)
	local card = Instance.new("Frame")
	card.Name = "InvDetailPanel"
	card.BorderSizePixel = 0
	card.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	card.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, Bars.detailHeight(metrics))
	card.Visible = false
	W.paint(card, "BackgroundColor3", "Header")
	card.Parent = content
	W.addCorner(card)
	W.addStroke(card)
	refs.InvDetail = card

	local inner = Instance.new("Frame")
	inner.Name = "Inner"
	inner.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	inner.Position = UDim2.new(0, DETAIL_PAD, 0, DETAIL_PAD)
	inner.Size = UDim2.new(1, -DETAIL_PAD * 2, 1, -DETAIL_PAD * 2)
	inner.Parent = card

	buildPreview(inner, refs, metrics)
	buildFacts(inner, refs, metrics)
	buildActions(inner, refs, metrics)
	return card
end

return Bars

--[[
	InventoryLayout/BottomRow  -  the row along the bottom of the Inventory in the theme modes other
	than Classic: a round filter button at the left, the search bar with its result count, and in
	the local lists a round add button at the right.
	  BottomRow.build(content, refs, metrics, skin) -> row, setTabsShown(shown), closeMenus()
	Filter button: opens a popover holding the filter tabs (All / Static / Flipbook / Favs / Recent,
	hidden through setTabsShown for lists without them) over the option list InventoryWiring fills
	and shows. The popover follows that list's Visible.
	Add button (refs.InvToolbar, shown by the wiring in local lists): its menu holds Import
	Selected, the import options, Upload and Dissect; the wiring shows the ones a list has.
	Both open upward and are children of their button, so they follow it when the row reflows.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Parent.Widgets)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.Parent.TypeScale)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

local GAP = 8
local MENU_Z = 20
-- Gap between a round button and the popover above it.
local POPOVER_LIFT = 6
-- Bars of the filter icon, widest first.
local FILTER_BARS = { 12, 8, 4 }

local BottomRow = {}

local function makeCircle(row, name, size, order)
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.Name = name
	button.Text = ""
	button.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
	button.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	button.BorderSizePixel = 0
	button.Size = UDim2.new(0, size, 0, size)
	button.LayoutOrder = order
	button.Parent = row
	W.addCorner(button, UDim.new(1, 0))
	W.addStroke(button)
	table.insert(W.getThemed().blobs, button)
	W.wireFieldStates(button)
	return button
end

local function buildFilter(row, refs, metrics, skin)
	local button = makeCircle(row, "FilterBtn", metrics.Circle, 1)
	refs.InvFilterBtn = button

	-- Three bars narrowing downward, drawn: the plugin has no icon images.
	local lines = {}
	for index, width in ipairs(FILTER_BARS) do
		local line = Instance.new("Frame")
		line.Name = "Bar" .. index
		line.BorderSizePixel = 0
		line.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		line.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, (index - 2) * 4)
		line.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, 2)
		line.Parent = button
		W.addCorner(line, UDim.new(1, 0))
		lines[index] = line
	end
	skin.setFilterButton(button, lines)

	local popover = W.makeMenu(button, "FilterPopover", metrics.FilterMenu)
	popover.Active = true
	popover.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	popover.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -POPOVER_LIFT)
	popover.ZIndex = MENU_Z

	local tabs = Instance.new("Frame")
	tabs.Name = "Tabs"
	tabs.BorderSizePixel = 0
	tabs.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, metrics.TabRow)
	tabs.LayoutOrder = 0
	W.paint(tabs, "BackgroundColor3", "Panel")
	tabs.Parent = popover
	W.addCorner(tabs)
	W.addPadding(tabs, 2, 2, 2, 2)
	W.addListLayout(tabs, 2, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)
	refs.TabAll = skin.addTab(tabs, "TabAll", "All", 0)
	refs.TabStatic = skin.addTab(tabs, "TabStatic", "Static", 1)
	refs.TabFlipbook = skin.addTab(tabs, "TabFlipbook", "Flipbook", 2)
	refs.TabFavourites = skin.addTab(tabs, "TabFavourites", "\u{2605} Favs", 3)
	refs.TabRecents = skin.addTab(tabs, "TabRecents", "Recent", 4)
	skin.setActiveTab(refs.TabAll)

	-- As tall as its options up to metrics.MenuMax, then it scrolls.
	local options = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	options.Name = "FilterDropdown"
	options.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	options.BorderSizePixel = 0
	options.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	options.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	options.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	options.ScrollBarThickness = 3
	options.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar
	options.LayoutOrder = 1
	options.Visible = false
	options.Parent = popover
	W.addListLayout(options, 2)
	table.insert(W.getThemed().scrollbars, options)
	refs.InvFilterDropdown = options

	local optionStep = LAYOUT.Row - 4 + 2
	local function fitToOptions()
		local count = 0
		for _, child in ipairs(options:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextButton") then
				count += 1
			end
		end
		options.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.min(count * optionStep, metrics.MenuMax))
	end
	options.ChildAdded:Connect(fitToOptions)
	options.ChildRemoved:Connect(fitToOptions)
	options:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		popover.Visible = options.Visible
	end)

	return function(shown)
		tabs.Visible = shown
	end
end

local function buildSearch(row, refs, metrics)

	refs.InvImportArrow = W.makeMenuItem(menu, "ImportArrow", "Import options \u{25BC}", 1)

	options.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y

		menu.Visible = not menu.Visible
	end)
	local function close()
		menu.Visible = false
	end
	-- An action closes the menu; the wiring's own handlers do the work.
	for _, action in ipairs({ refs.InvToolImport, refs.InvToolUpload, refs.InvToolDissect }) do

function BottomRow.build(content, refs, metrics, skin)

--[[
	InventoryLayout/EditMenu  -  the menu of the Edit button on the Inventory's multi-select
	strip, the same in every theme mode: what is changed on all selected local textures at once.
	  EditMenu.build(button, host, width, opensUp) -> parts
	      parts.menu                              hidden; the wiring shows it
	      parts.place()                           puts the menu at the button; called on opening
	      parts.gridBox                           a Grid for every selected texture, set on Enter
	      parts.list                              holds one row per custom filter
	      parts.makeRow(name, text, order) -> TextButton     a row of the list
	  EditMenu.makeInput(row, placeholder) -> TextBox     laid over a menu row, hidden until shown:
	                                                      a new filter's name, or a rename
	  EditMenu.addRowTools(row) -> rename, remove         "Rename" and "Delete" at the row's right
	                                                      end; the row's own text stops before them
	The menu is a child of `host` (the strip, or the panel in Classic), never of the button: a
	button as wide as its text grows to hold whatever is inside it. It opens over the grid: above
	the button where the strip docks at the bottom of the panel, below it in Classic, where the
	strip is at the top.
	InventoryWiring/InventoryEdit wires the parts; InventoryWiring/InventoryFilters uses the two
	row helpers on the Filters menu's own rows, in every mode.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Parent.Widgets)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.Parent.TypeScale)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

local MENU_Z = 30
-- Gap between the button and its menu.
local LIFT = 6
local GRID_LABEL = 40
local CAPTION_HEIGHT = 16
-- Rows shown before the list scrolls.
local MAX_ROWS = 6
-- A row tool's width, room for "Delete?": in text sizes, and in Classic, whose captions
-- keep one small size, in pixels.
local TOOL_WIDTH = 3.5
local TOOL_WIDTH_CLASSIC = 40
local TOOL_GAP = 2
local TOOL_MARGIN = 4

local EditMenu = {}

function EditMenu.makeInput(row, placeholder)
	local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
	box.Name = "Input"
	box.BorderSizePixel = 0
	box.Text = ""
	box.PlaceholderText = placeholder
	box.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold
	box.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	box.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	box.ZIndex = row.ZIndex + 2
	box.Visible = false
	TypeScale.style(box, "Label")
	W.paint(box, "BackgroundColor3", "Sunken")
	W.paint(box, "TextColor3", "TextPrimary")
	box.Parent = row
	W.addCorner(box)
	return box
end

function EditMenu.addRowTools(row)
	local toolWidth = C.MODE.Structure.Classic and TOOL_WIDTH_CLASSIC or math.floor(T.TextSize * TOOL_WIDTH)
	local width = toolWidth * 2 + TOOL_GAP

	-- The row's padding keeps its text clear of the tools, which sit in that padding.
	local padding = row:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding")
	if not padding then
		padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
		padding.Parent = row
	end
	padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, width + TOOL_MARGIN * 2)

	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Name = "Tools"
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	holder.Position = UDim2.new(1, width + TOOL_MARGIN, 0, 0)
	holder.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 1, 0)
	holder.ZIndex = row.ZIndex + 1
	holder.Parent = row
	W.addListLayout(holder, TOOL_GAP, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)

	local function makeTool(name, text, order, role)
		local tool = Instance.new("TextButton")
		tool.Name = name
		tool.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		tool.BorderSizePixel = 0
		tool.Text = text
		tool.Size = UDim2.new(0, toolWidth, 1, 0)
		tool.LayoutOrder = order
		tool.ZIndex = holder.ZIndex
		TypeScale.style(tool, "Caption")
		W.paint(tool, "TextColor3", role)
		tool.Parent = holder
		return tool
	end
	return makeTool("Rename", "Rename", 1, "TextSecondary"), makeTool("Remove", "Delete", 2, "Red")
end

function EditMenu.build(button, host, width, opensUp)
	local rowHeight = LAYOUT.Row - 4
	local rowStep = rowHeight + 2

	local menu = W.makeMenu(host, "EditMenu", width)
	menu.Active = true
	menu.ZIndex = MENU_Z
	menu.AnchorPoint = opensUp and Vector2.new(0, 1) or Vector2.new(1, 0)

	local gridBox, gridRow = W.makeNumberRow(menu, "Grid", "Grid", "", GRID_LABEL, 0)
	gridBox.PlaceholderText = "4 for 4x4, 0 for none"
	gridBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	gridRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row)

	W.makeDivider(menu, 1)

	local caption = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	caption.Name = "FiltersCaption"
	caption.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	caption.Text = "In filters"
	caption.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	caption.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, CAPTION_HEIGHT)
	caption.LayoutOrder = 2
	TypeScale.style(caption, "Caption")
	W.paint(caption, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
	caption.Parent = menu
	W.addPadding(caption, 8, 8, 0, 0)

	local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	list.Name = "Filters"
	list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	list.BorderSizePixel = 0
	list.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	list.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	list.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	list.ScrollBarThickness = 3
	list.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar
	list.LayoutOrder = 3
	list.Parent = menu
	W.addListLayout(list, 2)
	table.insert(W.getThemed().scrollbars, list)

	local function fitToRows()
		local count = 0
		for _, child in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextButton") then
				count += 1
			end
		end
		list.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.min(count, MAX_ROWS) * rowStep)
	end
	list.ChildAdded:Connect(fitToRows)
	list.ChildRemoved:Connect(fitToRows)

	local parts = { menu = menu, gridBox = gridBox, list = list }

	-- Above the button with its left edge on the button's, or below it with its right edge on
	-- the button's. In shares of the host, so no UIScale enters.
	function parts.place()
		local hostSize = host.AbsoluteSize
		if hostSize.X <= 0 or hostSize.Y <= 0 then
			return
		end
		local corner = button.AbsolutePosition - host.AbsolutePosition
		local left = corner.X / hostSize.X
		local top = corner.Y / hostSize.Y
		if opensUp then
			menu.Position = UDim2.new(left, 0, top, -LIFT)
		else
			local right = left + button.AbsoluteSize.X / hostSize.X
			local bottom = top + button.AbsoluteSize.Y / hostSize.Y
			menu.Position = UDim2.new(right, 0, bottom, LIFT)
		end
	end

	function parts.makeRow(name, text, order)
		local row = W.makeMenuItem(list, name, text, order)
		row.ZIndex = MENU_Z + 1
		return row
	end

	return parts
end

return EditMenu

--[[
	InventoryLayout/Skin  -  the parts of the Inventory that InventoryWiring creates and repaints
	at run time, in the theme modes other than Classic: grid tiles, the list tabs, filter tab and
	menu-option states.
	  Skin.new(metrics) -> skin, published as refs.InvSkin. Classic publishes none and the wiring
	  keeps its own original code for each of these.
	    skin.metrics                              Metrics.get()
	    skin.makeCell(grid, index) -> cell        the parts Grid.luau pools: wrapper, img, nameLabel,
	                                              highlight, quickInsert, favStar, typeBadge
	    skin.setCellHover(cell, hovered)
	    skin.setCellBadge(cell, entry)            a flipbook texture shows its grid; nothing else is badged
	    skin.buildLists(groups, onPick)           groups = { { title, modes = { { id, text }, ... } }, ... }.
	                                              One switch segment per group and one tab per list; a
	                                              click calls onPick(id). Picking a group picks the list
	                                              of the same name in it, or its first.
	    skin.setActiveList(id)
	    skin.addTab(parent, name, text, order) -> button   a filter tab (All, Static, ...)
	    skin.setActiveTab(button)
	    skin.makeMenuOption(menu, name, order) -> button
	    skin.setOptionActive(button, label, on)
	  Assigned by InventoryLayout: skin.layout(showTabs), skin.selection (the multi-select strip),
	  and the hosts through skin.setListHosts / skin.setFilterButton.
	Active states are kept here and repainted after a theme change.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Parent.Widgets)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.Parent.TypeScale)
local T = C.T

local RING = 2
local QUICK = 20
local BADGE_HEIGHT = 16
local ALL_TAB = "TabAll"

local Skin = {}

function Skin.new(metrics)
	local skin = { metrics = metrics }

	local tabs = {}
	local activeTab = nil
	local groupHost = nil
	local listHost = nil
	local groups = {}
	local groupButtons = {}
	local listButtons = {}
	local activeList = nil
	local filterButton = nil
	local filterLines = {}
	-- Option button -> whether it is ticked. Weak keys: the wiring destroys options on every rebuild.
	local optionOn = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

	local function groupOf(listId)
		for index, group in ipairs(groups) do
			for _, pair in ipairs(group.modes) do
				if pair[1] == listId then
					return index, pair[2]
				end
			end
		end
		return nil, nil
	end

	local function paintLists()
		local activeGroup = groupOf(activeList)
		for index, button in pairs(groupButtons) do
			W.paintSegment(button, index == activeGroup)
		end
		for listId, button in pairs(listButtons) do
			button.Visible = groupOf(listId) == activeGroup
			W.paintSegment(button, listId == activeList)
		end
	end

	-- The filter button is filled while a tab other than All or any option narrows the list.
	local function paintFilterButton()
		if not filterButton then
			return
		end
		local filtering = activeTab ~= nil and activeTab.Name ~= ALL_TAB
		for option, on in pairs(optionOn) do
			if on and option.Parent and option.Name ~= "All" then
				filtering = true
			end
		end
		filterButton.BackgroundColor3 = filtering and T.Accent or T.BlobBg
		for _, line in ipairs(filterLines) do
			line.BackgroundColor3 = filtering and T.OnAccent or T.MutedGold
		end
	end

	local function paintTabs()
		for _, tab in ipairs(tabs) do
			W.paintSegment(tab, tab == activeTab)
		end
		paintFilterButton()
	end

	-- Segments repaint themselves after a theme change (WidgetSegments); the filter button is ours.
	table.insert(W.getThemed().repaints, paintFilterButton)

	function skin.setListHosts(groupFrame, listFrame)
		groupHost = groupFrame
		listHost = listFrame
	end

	function skin.setFilterButton(button, lines)
		filterButton = button
		filterLines = lines
		paintFilterButton()
	end

	function skin.addTab(parent, name, text, order)
		local tab = W.makeSegment(parent, name, text, order, { fill = true })
		table.insert(tabs, tab)
		return tab
	end

	function skin.setActiveTab(button)
		activeTab = button
		paintTabs()
	end

	function skin.buildLists(groupList, onPick)
		for _, button in pairs(groupButtons) do
			button:Destroy()
		end
		for _, button in pairs(listButtons) do
			button:Destroy()
		end
		groups = groupList
		groupButtons = {}
		listButtons = {}

		local listOrder = 0
		for groupIndex, group in ipairs(groups) do
			local segment = W.makeSegment(groupHost, group.title, group.title, groupIndex)
			groupButtons[groupIndex] = segment
			segment.Activated:Connect(function()
				local activeGroup, activeText = groupOf(activeList)
				if activeGroup == groupIndex then
					return
				end
				local target = group.modes[1][1]
				for _, pair in ipairs(group.modes) do
					if pair[2] == activeText then
						target = pair[1]
					end
				end
				onPick(target)
			end)

			for _, pair in ipairs(group.modes) do
				local listId = pair[1]
				listOrder += 1
				local tab = W.makeSegment(listHost, listId, pair[2], listOrder, { fill = true })
				listButtons[listId] = tab
				tab.Activated:Connect(function()
					onPick(listId)
				end)
			end
		end
		paintLists()
	end

	function skin.setActiveList(listId)
		activeList = listId
		paintLists()
	end

	function skin.makeMenuOption(menu, name, order)
		return W.makeMenuItem(menu, name, name, order)
	end

	function skin.setOptionActive(button, label, on)
		button.Text = on and (label .. "  \u{2713}") or label
		button.TextColor3 = on and T.BrightGold or T.MutedGold
		optionOn[button] = on
		paintFilterButton()
	end

	-- One grid tile. The backing and the image are separate: InventoryWiring clears the image's own
	-- background and puts a 3D viewport between the two for assets and mesh frames.
	function skin.makeCell(grid, index)
		local tile = metrics.Tile
		local corner = UDim.new(0, metrics.TileCorner)

		local wrapper = Instance.new("Frame")
		wrapper.Name = "TW" .. index
		wrapper.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		wrapper.Size = UDim2.new(0, tile + metrics.TileGap, 0, tile + metrics.TileName + metrics.TileGap)
		wrapper.Parent = grid

		local backing = Instance.new("Frame")
		backing.Name = "Tile"
		backing.BorderSizePixel = 0
		backing.Size = UDim2.new(0, tile, 0, tile)
		backing.ZIndex = 0
		W.paint(backing, "BackgroundColor3", "Sunken")
		backing.Parent = wrapper
		W.addCorner(backing, corner)
		local outline = W.addStroke(backing)

		local image = Instance.new("ImageButton")
		image.Name = "Thumb"
		image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		image.BorderSizePixel = 0
		image.Size = UDim2.new(0, tile, 0, tile)
		image.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
		image.Parent = wrapper
		W.addCorner(image, corner)

		local ring = Instance.new("Frame")
		ring.Name = "HL"
		ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		ring.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		ring.ZIndex = 2
		ring.Visible = false
		ring.Parent = image
		W.addCorner(ring, corner)
		local ringStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		ringStroke.Thickness = RING
		ringStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
		W.paint(ringStroke, "Color", "Focus")
		ringStroke.Parent = ring

		local star = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		star.Name = "Fav"
		star.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		star.Text = "\u{2605}"
		star.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
		star.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 3)
		star.ZIndex = 3
		star.Visible = false
		TypeScale.style(star, "Caption")
		W.paint(star, "TextColor3", "Focus")
		star.Parent = image

		local quick = Instance.new("TextButton")
		quick.Name = "QI"
		quick.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
		quick.BorderSizePixel = 0
		quick.Text = "+"
		quick.Size = UDim2.new(0, QUICK, 0, QUICK)
		quick.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(QUICK + 4), 1, -(QUICK + 4))
		quick.ZIndex = 3
		quick.Visible = false
		TypeScale.style(quick, "Button")
		W.paint(quick, "TextColor3", "TextHeading")
		quick.Parent = image
		W.addCorner(quick, UDim.new(1, 0))
		W.addStroke(quick)
		table.insert(W.getThemed().blobs, quick)

		local badge = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		badge.Name = "TypeBadge"
		badge.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
		badge.BorderSizePixel = 0
		badge.Text = ""
		badge.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
		badge.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, BADGE_HEIGHT)
		badge.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 1, -(BADGE_HEIGHT + 4))
		badge.ZIndex = 3
		badge.Visible = false
		TypeScale.style(badge, "Caption")
		W.paint(badge, "BackgroundColor3", "Panel")
		W.paint(badge, "TextColor3", "TextLabel")
		badge.Parent = image
		W.addCorner(badge, UDim.new(0, 4))
		W.addPadding(badge, 5, 5, 0, 0)

		-- Always present: the wiring writes the entry's name here and the tooltip reads it back.
		local name = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		name.Name = "Name"
		name.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		name.Text = ""
		name.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		name.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		name.Size = UDim2.new(0, tile, 0, metrics.TileName)
		name.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, tile + 2)
		name.Visible = metrics.TileName > 0
		TypeScale.style(name, "Caption")
		W.paint(name, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
		name.Parent = wrapper

		return {
			wrapper = wrapper, img = image, nameLabel = name, highlight = ring,
			quickInsert = quick, favStar = star, typeBadge = badge, outline = outline,
		}
	end

	function skin.setCellHover(cell, hovered)
		cell.outline.Color = hovered and T.OutlineHover or T.Border
	end

	function skin.setCellBadge(cell, entry)
		local grid = entry.grid
		local isSheet = entry._type == nil and grid ~= nil and grid > 1
		cell.typeBadge.Visible = isSheet
		if isSheet then
			cell.typeBadge.Text = grid .. "\u{00D7}" .. grid
		end
	end

	return skin
end

return Skin

--[[
	InventoryPanel  -  Part-Icles V5
	Copyright (C) 2026 Qwinkle
	Builds the Inventory panel UI of the Classic theme mode: sidebar, tabs, thumbnail grid,
	detail popup, loading/error states, tooltip, result count. Returns refs table for wiring.
	InventoryLayout builds the panel in the other modes and takes buildDetail / buildDialogs
	from here.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Widgets)
local MiniSlider = require(script.Parent.MiniSlider)
local T = C.T

local SCALE_SLIDER_W = 96

local PANEL_W, PANEL_H = 600, 380
local SIDEBAR_W = 110
local TAB_H = 24
local SEARCH_H = 26
-- Detail panel width is defined inline (DETAIL_PANEL_W)

-- Alias canonical Widgets.addCorner.
local addCorner = W.addCorner

local InventoryPanel = {}

-- Details panel: a separate panel beside the inventory, placed by InventoryWiring.
local function buildDetail(sg, refs, _themed)
	local DETAIL_PANEL_W = 200
	local detail = Instance.new("Frame"); detail.Name = "InvDetailPanel"
	detail.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; detail.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	detail.Size = UDim2.new(0, DETAIL_PANEL_W, 0, PANEL_H)
	detail.Visible = false
	detail.ClipsDescendants = true; detail.Parent = sg
	addCorner(detail, T.BigCorner); W.addStroke(detail); table.insert(_themed.panels, detail)
	local dp = Instance.new("UIPadding"); dp.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8); dp.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)
	dp.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4); dp.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8); dp.Parent = detail
	local detailScale = Instance.new("UIScale"); detailScale.Name = "PanelScale"; detailScale.Parent = detail
	refs.InvDetailScale = detailScale
	refs.InvDetail = detail

	-- Detail header (draggable)
	local dHeader = Instance.new("Frame"); dHeader.Name = "Header"; dHeader.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	dHeader.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20); dHeader.Parent = detail
	local dTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel"); dTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1; dTitle.Text = "Details"
	dTitle.TextColor3 = T.Gold; dTitle.Font = T.Font; dTitle.TextSize = 11

function InventoryPanel.build(sg)
	local refs = {}
	local _themed = W.getThemed()

	-- Main panel
	local panel = Instance.new("Frame"); panel.Name = "InventoryPanel"
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, PANEL_W, 0, PANEL_H); panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -PANEL_W/2, 0.2, 0)
	panel.Visible = false; panel.ClipsDescendants = true; panel.Active = true; panel.Parent = sg
	addCorner(panel, T.BigCorner); W.addStroke(panel)
	table.insert(_themed.panels, panel)
	-- Inventory uses a custom 3-layer background instead of the global sibling-overlay helper.
	-- Negative ZIndex on bg + image so default-ZIndex content (grid scroller, sidebar buttons,
	-- search input  -  anything that doesn't set ZIndex explicitly defaults to 1) still renders
	-- ON TOP without each content widget having to opt in. Layering, back to front:
	--   ImageLabel (ZIndex=-2)  -  BgImage at the very back.
	--   bg Frame   (ZIndex=-1)  -  theme color + (inverted) transparency. Sits IN FRONT of the
	--                  image so the image only shows through the bg's transparency.
	--   content    (ZIndex >= 1, defaults or explicit 10/25/50 etc.)
	local bg = Instance.new("Frame"); bg.Name = "Background"
	bg.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; bg.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
	bg.BorderSizePixel = 0; bg.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0); bg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	bg.ZIndex = -1; bg.Parent = panel
	table.insert(_themed.panels, bg)
	local bgImage = Instance.new("ImageLabel"); bgImage.Name = "PanelBackgroundImage"
	bgImage.BackgroundTransparency = 1; bgImage.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bgImage.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	bgImage.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0); bgImage.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	bgImage.ZIndex = -2; bgImage.Image = T.BgImage or ""
	bgImage.ImageTransparency = T.BgImageTransparency or 1
	bgImage.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch; bgImage.Parent = panel
	table.insert(_themed.panelImages, bgImage)
	refs.InventoryPanel = panel
	W.makeResizable(panel, 600, 40)
	-- Its grid scrolls, so it gives way to a panel opened over it (PanelPush).
	W.allowPush(panel, 600, 40)
	-- Whole-panel scale (header slider; InventoryWiring persists it and mirrors it onto the detail panel).
	local panelScale = Instance.new("UIScale"); panelScale.Name = "PanelScale"; panelScale.Parent = panel
	refs.InvScale = panelScale


	-- Header
	local header = Instance.new("Frame"); header.Name = "Header"; header.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22); header.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 4); header.ZIndex = 10; header.Parent = panel
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel"); title.BackgroundTransparency = 1; title.Text = "Inventory"
	title.TextColor3 = T.Gold; title.Font = T.Font; title.TextSize = 12
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(34 + SCALE_SLIDER_W), 1, 0)
	title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0); title.Parent = header
	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); closeBtn.Name = "Close"; closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	closeBtn.Text = "X"; closeBtn.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; closeBtn.Font = T.Font; closeBtn.TextSize = 11
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, 0); closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 0); closeBtn.ZIndex = 12; closeBtn.Parent = header
	refs.InventoryClose = closeBtn
	local scaleSlider = MiniSlider.new(header, T, { name = "Scale", min = 0.3, max = 1.5, default = 1, width = SCALE_SLIDER_W, height = 16, zIndex = 12 })
	scaleSlider.frame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(28 + SCALE_SLIDER_W), 0, 3)
	table.insert(_themed.blobs, scaleSlider.track); table.insert(_themed.fills, scaleSlider.fill)
	for _, conn in ipairs(scaleSlider.conns) do table.insert(W.getUISConnections(), conn) end
	refs.InvScaleSlider = scaleSlider
	-- Drag handle
	local dragH = Instance.new("TextButton"); dragH.BackgroundTransparency = 1; dragH.Text = ""
	dragH.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, 0); dragH.ZIndex = 11; dragH.Parent = header
	W.makeDraggable(panel, dragH)

	local contentY = 28

	-- Search bar + result count + filter button
	local FILTER_W = 64; local SEARCH_GAP = 4
	local searchWrap = Instance.new("Frame"); searchWrap.Name = "Search"; searchWrap.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
	-- Proportional Size so the frame reflows when the panel resizes. Width =

--[[
	MiniSlider  -  Part-Icles V5
	Copyright (C) 2026 Qwinkle
	Compact horizontal slider for panel headers (graph editor / inventory panel scale): track,
	fill, handle and a value label in one frame. Callers register the returned parts with their
	own theme tracking and disconnect `slider.conns` on teardown.

	MiniSlider.new(parent, theme, opts) -> slider
	  opts: name, min, max, default, width (96), height (16), fmt ("%.2fx"), zIndex (1),
	        onChanged(value) on every move, onRelease(value) on mouse-up after a drag.
	  slider.frame / track / fill / handle / label / conns
	  slider.set(value, silent), slider.get(), slider.onChanged / slider.onRelease (reassignable)

	MiniSlider.bindPanelScale(slider, panel, theme, applyFn, baseScale)
	  Preview-then-apply for a panel UIScale: dragging shows a translucent outline of the panel at
	  the slider value; applyFn(value) runs on release. Applying live would rescale the slider under
	  the cursor and skew the drag. baseScale (default 1) is what applyFn multiplies the value by,
	  so the outline matches the size the panel will take.
]]

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local MiniSlider = {}

local LABEL_W = 28
local TRACK_H = 6

local function addCorner(instance, radius)
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
	corner.Parent = instance
end

function MiniSlider.new(parent, theme, opts)
	local width = opts.width or 96
	local height = opts.height or 16
	local zIndex = opts.zIndex or 1
	local fmt = opts.fmt or "%.2fx"
	local minVal, maxVal = opts.min, opts.max

	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = opts.name or "MiniSlider"
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, height)
	frame.ZIndex = zIndex
	frame.Parent = parent

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "Val"
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.TextColor3 = theme.MutedGold
	label.Font = theme.Font
	label.TextSize = 8
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	label.Size = UDim2.new(0, LABEL_W, 1, 0)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(1, -LABEL_W, 0, 0)
	label.ZIndex = zIndex + 1
	label.Parent = frame

	local track = Instance.new("Frame")
	track.Name = "Track"
	track.BorderSizePixel = 0
	track.BackgroundColor3 = theme.BlobBg
	track.BackgroundTransparency = theme.BlobAlpha
	track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(LABEL_W + 4), 0, TRACK_H)
	track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -TRACK_H / 2)
	track.ZIndex = zIndex + 1
	track.Parent = frame
	addCorner(track, 3)

	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.Name = "Fill"
	fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = theme.SliderFill or theme.Gold
	fill.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
	fill.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
	fill.ZIndex = zIndex + 2
	fill.Parent = track
	addCorner(fill, 3)

	local handle = Instance.new("Frame")
	handle.Name = "Handle"
	handle.BorderSizePixel = 0
	handle.BackgroundColor3 = theme.BrightGold
	handle.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
	handle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 10)
	handle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	handle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	handle.ZIndex = zIndex + 3
	handle.Parent = track
	addCorner(handle, 4)

	-- One invisible button the full height of the frame catches clicks anywhere along the track.
	local hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
	hit.Name = "Hit"
	hit.Text = ""
	hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hit.AutoButtonColor = false
	hit.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
	hit.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -height / 2)
	hit.ZIndex = zIndex + 4
	hit.Parent = track

	local slider = { frame = frame, track = track, fill = fill, handle = handle, label = label, conns = {} }
	slider.onChanged = opts.onChanged
	slider.onRelease = opts.onRelease

	local current = opts.default or minVal
	local dragging = false

	function slider.set(value, silent)
		current = math.clamp(value, minVal, maxVal)
		local alpha = (current - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal)
		fill.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 1, 0)
		handle.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 0.5, 0)
		label.Text = string.format(fmt, current)
		if not silent and slider.onChanged then slider.onChanged(current) end
	end

	function slider.get()
		return current
	end

	local function updateFromInput(input)
		local trackX, trackW = track.AbsolutePosition.X, track.AbsoluteSize.X
		if trackW <= 0 then return end
		slider.set(minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * math.clamp((input.Position.X - trackX) / trackW, 0, 1))
	end

	hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
		dragging = true
		updateFromInput(input)
	end)
	table.insert(slider.conns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then updateFromInput(input) end
	end))
	table.insert(slider.conns, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if not dragging or input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
		dragging = false
		if slider.onRelease then slider.onRelease(current) end
	end))

	slider.set(current, true)
	return slider
end

-- Product of the UIScales above `panel` (Position / AbsolutePosition live in that space).
local function outerScale(panel)
	local scale = 1
	local node = panel.Parent
	while node and node:IsA("GuiBase2d") do
		local uiScale = node:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		if uiScale then scale = scale * uiScale.Scale end
		node = node.Parent
	end
	return math.max(scale, 0.01)
end

local function makePreview(panel, theme)
	local preview = Instance.new("Frame")
	preview.Name = "ScalePreview"
	preview.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Gold
	preview.BackgroundTransparency = 0.85
	preview.BorderSizePixel = 0
	preview.ZIndex = 100
	preview.Visible = false
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = theme.Gold
	stroke.Thickness = 1
	stroke.Parent = preview
	addCorner(preview, 8)
	preview.Parent = panel:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui") or panel.Parent
	return preview
end

function MiniSlider.bindPanelScale(slider, panel, theme, applyFn, baseScale)
	local preview
	slider.onChanged = function(value)
		if not preview or not preview.Parent then preview = makePreview(panel, theme) end
		local outer = outerScale(panel)
		local ownScale = panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		local size = panel.AbsoluteSize / outer / (ownScale and ownScale.Scale or 1) * value * (baseScale or 1)
		local position = panel.AbsolutePosition / outer
		preview.Position = UDim2.new(0, position.X, 0, position.Y)
		preview.Size = UDim2.new(0, size.X, 0, size.Y)
		preview.Visible = true
	end
	slider.onRelease = function(value)
		if preview then preview.Visible = false end
		applyFn(value)
	end
end

return MiniSlider

--[[
	PanelChrome  -  the shared frame of a panel in the theme modes other than Classic: the panel
	surface, its title bar, and the two row shapes small panels are made of.
	Loaded by Widgets.luau; receives the shared W table and adds:
	  W.makePanel(parent, name, width)            padded panel that grows with its list of rows
	  W.makeTitleBar(panel, title, order)         { header, title, close }; spans the panel's width
	  W.makeNumberRow(parent, name, label, text, labelWidth, order)   label + right-aligned input
	  W.makeSwitchRow(parent, name, label, order)                     label + switch at the right
	  W.makeActionButton(parent, name, text, order, textRole)         full-width button
	  W.makeTextButton(parent, name, text, order, textRole)           button as wide as its text
	  W.makeButtonRow(parent, name, specs, order) -> buttons, row     equal buttons side by side
	  W.makeTextField(parent, name, text, alignment) -> box, field    a bare input field
	  W.makeSearchField(parent, name, placeholder) -> box, field      search-height field
	  W.makeDivider(parent, order)                                    hairline between row groups
	  W.makeRowFrame(parent, name, order) / W.makeRowLabel(row, text, width)   a bare row and its label,
	      for rows whose value side a builder lays out itself
	  W.makeMenu(parent, name, width) / W.makeMenuItem(menu, name, text, order)   a popup menu and its rows
	Classic builds its panels with its own original code and does not call these.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.TypeScale)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

return function(W)
	-- A panel that sizes itself to a vertical list of rows.
	function W.makePanel(parent, name, width)
		local pad = LAYOUT.PanelPad
		local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
		panel.Name = name
		panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg
		panel.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
		panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
		panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, 0)
		panel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		panel.Active = true
		panel.Parent = parent
		W.addCorner(panel, T.BigCorner)
		W.addStroke(panel)
		W.addPadding(panel, pad, pad, pad, pad)
		W.addListLayout(panel, LAYOUT.RowGap)
		table.insert(W.getThemed().panels, panel)
		W.attachPanelBackground(panel)
		return panel
	end

	-- Title bar as a row of the panel's list. The bar itself reaches past the panel padding to
	-- the panel's edges; a filled bar rounds its top with the panel and squares its bottom.
	function W.makeTitleBar(panel, titleText, order)
		local pad = LAYOUT.PanelPad
		local item = Instance.new("Frame")
		item.Name = "TitleBar"
		item.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		-- The bar starts `pad` above this item, so the row after it lands one panel padding below the bar.
		item.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.TitleBar - LAYOUT.RowGap)
		item.LayoutOrder = order or 0
		item.Parent = panel

		local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
		bar.Name = "Bar"
		bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
		bar.Position = UDim2.new(0, -pad, 0, -pad)
		bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, pad * 2, 0, LAYOUT.TitleBar)
		bar.Parent = item
		if C.MODE.Structure.TitleBarFill then
			W.paint(bar, "BackgroundColor3", "Header")
			W.addCorner(bar, T.BigCorner)
			local squareBottom = Instance.new("Frame")
			squareBottom.Name = "SquareBottom"
			squareBottom.BorderSizePixel = 0
			squareBottom.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
			squareBottom.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
			W.paint(squareBottom, "BackgroundColor3", "Header")
			squareBottom.Parent = bar
		else
			bar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		end

		local rule = Instance.new("Frame")
		rule.Name = "Rule"
		rule.BorderSizePixel = 0
		rule.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -1)
		rule.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1)
		W.paint(rule, "BackgroundColor3", "PanelStroke")
		rule.Parent = bar

		-- Controls sit inside the panel padding, level with the rows below.
		local header = Instance.new("Frame")
		header.Name = "Header"
		header.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		header.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -pad)
		header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.TitleBar)
		header.Parent = item

		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		title.Name = "Title"
		title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Text = titleText
		title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.IconSlot, 1, 0)
		TypeScale.style(title, "Title")
		W.paint(title, "TextColor3", "TextPrimary")
		title.Parent = header

		local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
		close.Name = "Close"
		close.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		close.Text = "\u{00D7}"
		close.Size = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.IconSlot, 1, 0)
		close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.IconSlot, 0, 0)
		close.ZIndex = 3
		TypeScale.style(close, "Glyph")
		W.paint(close, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
		close.Parent = header

		local dragHandle = Instance.new("TextButton")
		dragHandle.Name = "DragHandle"
		dragHandle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		dragHandle.Text = ""
		dragHandle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.IconSlot, 1, 0)
		dragHandle.ZIndex = 2
		dragHandle.Parent = header

		return { header = header, title = title, close = close, dragHandle = dragHandle }
	end

	-- Plain row label on the left of a row.
	function W.makeRowLabel(row, labelText, labelWidth)
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Name = "Label"
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Text = labelText
		label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		label.Size = UDim2.new(0, labelWidth, 1, 0)
		TypeScale.style(label, "Label")
		W.paint(label, "TextColor3", "TextLabel")
		label.Parent = row
		return label
	end

	function W.makeRowFrame(parent, name, order)
		local row = Instance.new("Frame")
		row.Name = name
		row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row)
		row.LayoutOrder = order or 0
		row.Parent = parent
		return row
	end

	-- An input field one row tall and as wide as its parent. Returns the input and the field.
	function W.makeTextField(parent, name, text, alignment)
		local field = W.makeBlob(name .. "InputWrap", parent, UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row))

		local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
		box.Name = name .. "Box"
		box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		box.Text = text
		box.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
		box.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold
		box.TextXAlignment = alignment or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
		box.BorderSizePixel = 0
		box.Position = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.FieldPad, 0, 0)
		box.Size = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.FieldPad * 2, 1, 0)
		TypeScale.style(box, "Number")
		box.Parent = field
		W.wireFieldStates(field, box)
		return box, field
	end

	-- A search input as wide as its parent.
	function W.makeSearchField(parent, name, placeholder)
		local box, field = W.makeTextField(parent, name, "")
		field.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Search)
		box.PlaceholderText = placeholder
		TypeScale.style(box, "Value")
		return box, field
	end

	-- Label on the left, a right-aligned text input filling the rest. Returns the input and the row.
	function W.makeNumberRow(parent, name, labelText, defaultText, labelWidth, order)
		local row = W.makeRowFrame(parent, name, order)
		W.makeRowLabel(row, labelText, labelWidth)

		local offset = labelWidth + LAYOUT.LabelGap
		local box, field = W.makeTextField(row, name, defaultText, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right)
		field.Position = UDim2.new(0, offset, 0, 0)
		field.Size = UDim2.new(1, -offset, 1, 0)
		return box, row
	end

	-- Label on the left, the mode's switch (or checkbox) at the right edge. Returns the toggle,
	-- the row and the label.
	function W.makeSwitchRow(parent, name, labelText, order)
		local row = W.makeRowFrame(parent, name .. "Row", order)
		local label = W.makeRowLabel(row, labelText, 0)
		label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(LAYOUT.ToggleWidth + LAYOUT.LabelGap), 1, 0)

		local toggle = W.makeToggle(name, row, true)
		toggle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		toggle.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
		return toggle, row, label
	end

	-- A popup menu: a solid outlined surface as tall as its items, hidden until its opener shows it.
	function W.makeMenu(parent, name, width)
		local menu = Instance.new("Frame")
		menu.Name = name
		menu.BorderSizePixel = 0
		menu.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, 0)
		menu.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		menu.Visible = false
		W.paint(menu, "BackgroundColor3", "Field")
		menu.Parent = parent
		W.addCorner(menu)
		W.addStroke(menu)
		W.addPadding(menu, 4, 4, 4, 4)
		W.addListLayout(menu, 2)
		return menu
	end

	-- A menu row: text at the left, lit under the cursor. Its text colour is the caller's to
	-- change (a menu greys out what cannot be used).
	function W.makeMenuItem(menu, name, text, order)
		local item = Instance.new("TextButton")
		item.Name = name
		item.Text = text
		item.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		item.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		item.AutoButtonColor = false
		item.BorderSizePixel = 0
		item.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		item.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row - 4)
		item.LayoutOrder = order or 0
		TypeScale.style(item, "Label")
		item.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
		W.paint(item, "BackgroundColor3", "FieldHover")
		item.Parent = menu
		W.addCorner(item)
		W.addPadding(item, 8, 8, 0, 0)
		item.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			if W.pointerBlocked(item) then return end
			item.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		end)
		item.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			item.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		end)
		return item
	end

	-- A hairline between groups of rows, with a little air on both sides.
	function W.makeDivider(parent, order)
		local divider = Instance.new("Frame")
		divider.Name = "Divider"
		divider.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		divider.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 5)
		divider.LayoutOrder = order or 0
		divider.Parent = parent

		local line = Instance.new("Frame")
		line.Name = "Line"
		line.BorderSizePixel = 0
		line.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
		line.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1)
		W.paint(line, "BackgroundColor3", "Divider")
		line.Parent = divider
		return divider
	end

	-- A button as wide as its parent, one row tall. textRole (default TextPrimary) colours its text.
	function W.makeActionButton(parent, name, text, order, textRole)
		local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
		button.Name = name
		button.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
		button.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
		button.BorderSizePixel = 0
		button.AutoButtonColor = true
		button.Text = text
		button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row)
		button.LayoutOrder = order or 0
		TypeScale.style(button, "Button")
		W.paint(button, "TextColor3", textRole or "TextPrimary")
		button.Parent = parent
		W.addCorner(button)
		W.addStroke(button)
		table.insert(W.getThemed().blobs, button)
		W.wireFieldStates(button)
		return button
	end

	-- A button as wide as its text and as tall as its parent, for rows of buttons of unequal width.
	function W.makeTextButton(parent, name, text, order, textRole)
		local button = W.makeActionButton(parent, name, text, order, textRole)
		button.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
		button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
		W.addPadding(button, 10, 10, 0, 0)
		return button
	end

	-- Equal buttons side by side in one row. specs = { { name, text, role? }, ... }; returns the
	-- buttons in that order, then the row.
	function W.makeButtonRow(parent, name, specs, order)
		local gap = LAYOUT.RowGap
		local row = W.makeRowFrame(parent, name, order)
		W.addListLayout(row, gap, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)

		local count = #specs
		local buttons = {}
		for index, spec in ipairs(specs) do
			local button = W.makeActionButton(row, spec.name, spec.text, index, spec.role)
			button.Size = UDim2.new(1 / count, -gap * (count - 1) / count, 1, 0)
			buttons[index] = button
		end
		return buttons, row
	end
end

--[[
	PanelPush  -  a panel whose content scrolls (Properties, the Inventory) gives way to a panel
	opened or moved over it. The covered edge slides back until the two no longer overlap, or
	until the panel is at its minimum size, and slides out again once the other panel moves off
	or closes. Tool panels lay their controls out at fixed places; a push would only cut them
	off, so they stay as they are.
	Loaded by Widgets.luau after PanelStack; receives the shared W table and adds:
	  W.allowPush(panel, minWidth, minHeight)  called by a panel's builder: the panel may give way,
	                                           down to the size its resize handles stop at
	  W.watchPanelPush(screenGui)              starts it for that ScreenGui's stacked panels, once
	                                           they are built and placed
	  W.requestPanelPush()                     called by PanelStack whenever the layers change
	  W.panelArrived(panel)                    called by Widgets.makeDraggable / makeResizable as a
	                                           panel is moved or resized by hand
	  W.panelPushed(panel) -> boolean          true while a push holds the panel smaller
	  W.restingPosition(panel) -> UDim2        the panel's own place, which it returns to
	  W.restingSize(panel) -> UDim2            and its own size
	  W.releasePushes()                        every panel back to its own place at once
	Who yields: panels are kept in the order they last arrived, which is when one is opened,
	dragged or resized by hand. A panel yields to those that arrived after it. A press alone
	changes a panel's layer (PanelStack) but not this order, so a pushed panel keeps its size
	while it is worked in. Rules.giveWay picks the edge.
	Mutates: Position and Size of the LIVE panels for as long as a push lasts. Nothing is saved.
	Refreshed by: a stacked panel moving, resizing, showing or hiding.
	A write from other code to a pushed panel is taken over on the next frame: a new Position
	moves the panel's own place by the same step (a drag), a new Size becomes its own size on
	that axis (a resize, a collapse).
	Cross-file:
	  - Code that keeps a panel's place or size reads W.restingPosition / W.restingSize, never
	    Position / Size: PanelPersistence (saved positions), WidgetSections.makeCollapse (size to
	    expand to), PropertiesTabs (height of the list view).
	  - Code that sets a Position outright calls W.releasePushes() first: Reset Layout (UIBuilder),
	    PanelPersistence (restored positions).
	  - PropertiesTabs sizes its own panel and leaves the height alone while W.panelPushed(panel).
	  - Workspaces tells a parked panel by its Position, so a panel carrying _workspaceParked is
	    neither written nor counted here.
]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Rules = require(script.Rules)

-- Space kept between a pushed edge and the panel in front, before the UI scale.
local GAP = 6
-- Height a push always leaves, before the UI scale: the title, the search bar and a few rows.
-- The resize handles go lower, down to a bare title.
local FLOOR_HEIGHT = 160
-- Exponential approach: each frame covers 1 - exp(-FOLLOW_RATE * dt) of the travel left.
local FOLLOW_RATE = 18
local SETTLE_PIXELS = 0.5
local PARKED_ATTRIBUTE = "_workspaceParked"
local EDGES = { "Left", "Top", "Right", "Bottom" }
-- Position and Size as well as the absolute pair: a ScreenGui that is switched off lays out
-- only when read and announces no absolute change.
local WATCHED = { "Position", "Size", "AbsolutePosition", "AbsoluteSize" }

return function(W)
	local gui = nil
	-- panel -> { minWidth, minHeight, held, inset, goal, restPosition, restSize, writtenPosition,
	-- writtenSize }. inset and goal are per edge in screen pixels: how far the edge is pushed in,
	-- and how far it is heading. The rest and written fields exist only while held.
	local pushable = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local tracked = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	-- Tracked panels, the one that arrived last at the end.
	local arrivals = {}
	local dirty = false
	local moving = false
	local frameConnection = nil

	function W.requestPanelPush()
		dirty = true
	end

	-- Popups and dialogs are draggable too but never tracked: they push nothing.
	function W.panelArrived(panel)
		if not tracked[panel] or arrivals[#arrivals] == panel then
			return
		end
		local index = table.find(arrivals, panel)
		if index then
			table.remove(arrivals, index)
		end
		table.insert(arrivals, panel)
		dirty = true
	end

	-- Screen pixels per Position offset and per Size offset. A panel's own UIScale scales its
	-- Size but not its Position.
	local function scalesOf(panel)
		local guiScale = gui:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		local screenScale = 1
		if guiScale and guiScale.Scale > 0 then
			screenScale = guiScale.Scale
		end
		local ownScale = panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		local sizeScale = screenScale
		if ownScale and ownScale.Scale > 0 then
			sizeScale = screenScale * ownScale.Scale
		end
		return screenScale, sizeScale
	end

	-- Takes over what other code wrote to a pushed panel since this module's last write.
	local function absorb(panel, state)
		local position = panel.Position
		local size = panel.Size
		if position ~= state.writtenPosition then
			state.restPosition += position - state.writtenPosition
			state.writtenPosition = position
		end
		if size ~= state.writtenSize then
			local restX = state.restSize.X
			local restY = state.restSize.Y
			if size.X ~= state.writtenSize.X then
				restX = size.X
				state.inset.Left = 0
				state.inset.Right = 0
			end
			if size.Y ~= state.writtenSize.Y then
				restY = size.Y
				state.inset.Top = 0
				state.inset.Bottom = 0
			end
			state.restSize = UDim2.new(restX, restY)
			state.writtenSize = size
		end
	end

	-- Applies the panel's own place less its insets. Offsets are whole numbers, and rounding the
	-- two the same way keeps the edge that is not pushed still.
	local function write(panel, state)
		local inset = state.inset
		local screenScale, sizeScale = scalesOf(panel)
		local anchor = panel.AnchorPoint
		local restPosition = state.restPosition
		local restSize = state.restSize
		local shiftX = (inset.Left * (1 - anchor.X) - inset.Right * anchor.X) / screenScale
		local shiftY = (inset.Top * (1 - anchor.Y) - inset.Bottom * anchor.Y) / screenScale
		local lostWidth = (inset.Left + inset.Right) / sizeScale
		local lostHeight = (inset.Top + inset.Bottom) / sizeScale
		panel.Position = UDim2.new(
			restPosition.X.Scale, math.round(restPosition.X.Offset + shiftX),
			restPosition.Y.Scale, math.round(restPosition.Y.Offset + shiftY)
		)
		panel.Size = UDim2.new(
			restSize.X.Scale, math.round(restSize.X.Offset - lostWidth),
			restSize.Y.Scale, math.round(restSize.Y.Offset - lostHeight)
		)
		state.writtenPosition = panel.Position
		state.writtenSize = panel.Size
	end

	local function hold(panel, state)
		state.held = true
		state.restPosition = panel.Position
		state.restSize = panel.Size
		state.writtenPosition = panel.Position
		state.writtenSize = panel.Size
	end

	-- Puts a pushed panel back at its own place without the slide.
	local function release(panel, state)
		absorb(panel, state)
		for _, edge in ipairs(EDGES) do
			state.inset[edge] = 0
			state.goal[edge] = 0
		end
		write(panel, state)
		state.held = false
	end

	-- The panel's box on screen at its own place: its current box with the push taken back out.
	-- Exact only right after absorb, when the written values are the panel's.
	local function restRect(panel, state)
		local origin = panel.AbsolutePosition
		local size = panel.AbsoluteSize
		local rect = { Left = origin.X, Top = origin.Y, Right = origin.X + size.X, Bottom = origin.Y + size.Y }
		if not (state and state.held) then
			return rect
		end
		local screenScale, sizeScale = scalesOf(panel)
		local anchor = panel.AnchorPoint
		local width = size.X + (state.restSize.X.Offset - state.writtenSize.X.Offset) * sizeScale
		local height = size.Y + (state.restSize.Y.Offset - state.writtenSize.Y.Offset) * sizeScale
		local pointX = origin.X + anchor.X * size.X
			+ (state.restPosition.X.Offset - state.writtenPosition.X.Offset) * screenScale
		local pointY = origin.Y + anchor.Y * size.Y
			+ (state.restPosition.Y.Offset - state.writtenPosition.Y.Offset) * screenScale
		rect.Left = pointX - anchor.X * width
		rect.Right = rect.Left + width
		rect.Top = pointY - anchor.Y * height
		rect.Bottom = rect.Top + height
		return rect
	end

	-- Sets a pushable panel's goal from the boxes in front, and shrinks `rect` (its box at its
	-- own place) to the box it will end up with.
	local function aim(panel, state, rect, front)
		local screenScale, sizeScale = scalesOf(panel)
		local restLeft = rect.Left
		local restTop = rect.Top
		local restRight = rect.Right
		local restBottom = rect.Bottom
		-- A panel already under its minimum (collapsed to its title) does not shrink on that axis.
		local floorWidth = math.min(state.minWidth * sizeScale, restRight - restLeft)
		local floorHeight = math.min(math.max(state.minHeight, FLOOR_HEIGHT) * sizeScale, restBottom - restTop)
		for _, other in ipairs(front) do
			if Rules.overlaps(rect, other) then
				Rules.giveWay(rect, other, floorWidth, floorHeight, GAP * screenScale)
			end
		end

		local goal = state.goal
		goal.Left = rect.Left - restLeft
		goal.Top = rect.Top - restTop
		goal.Right = restRight - rect.Right
		goal.Bottom = restBottom - rect.Bottom
		local pushed = goal.Left > 0 or goal.Top > 0 or goal.Right > 0 or goal.Bottom > 0
		if pushed and not state.held then
			hold(panel, state)
		end
	end

	local function track(panel)
		if tracked[panel] then
			return
		end
		tracked[panel] = true
		table.insert(arrivals, panel)
		local connections = W.getUISConnections()
		for _, property in ipairs(WATCHED) do
			table.insert(connections, panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property):Connect(W.requestPanelPush))
		end
		table.insert(connections, panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
			if panel.Visible then
				W.panelArrived(panel)
			end
			dirty = true
		end))
		table.insert(connections, panel:GetAttributeChangedSignal(PARKED_ATTRIBUTE):Connect(W.requestPanelPush))
	end

	-- Works out every goal, from the last arrival back: each panel yields to the boxes the
	-- panels that arrived after it will end up with.
	local function solve()
		-- A panel PanelStack has taken in since the last pass joins in its layer order.
		for _, panel in ipairs(W.getPanelOrder()) do
			track(panel)
		end
		local front = {}
		for index = #arrivals, 1, -1 do
			local panel = arrivals[index]
			local state = pushable[panel]
			if panel.Parent ~= gui then
				table.remove(arrivals, index)
				continue
			end
			if panel:GetAttribute(PARKED_ATTRIBUTE) then
				continue
			end
			if not panel.Visible then
				if state and state.held then
					release(panel, state)
				end
				continue
			end
			if state and state.held then
				absorb(panel, state)
			end
			local rect = restRect(panel, state)
			if state then
				aim(panel, state, rect, front)
			end
			table.insert(front, rect)
		end
	end

	-- Moves every pushed panel one frame toward its goal. Returns whether any is still travelling.
	local function advance(deltaTime)
		local share = 1 - math.exp(-FOLLOW_RATE * deltaTime)
		local travelling = false
		for panel, state in pairs(pushable) do
			if not state.held or panel.Parent ~= gui or panel:GetAttribute(PARKED_ATTRIBUTE) then
				continue
			end
			absorb(panel, state)
			local atRest = true
			for _, edge in ipairs(EDGES) do
				local remaining = state.goal[edge] - state.inset[edge]
				if math.abs(remaining) <= SETTLE_PIXELS then
					state.inset[edge] = state.goal[edge]
				else
					state.inset[edge] += remaining * share
					travelling = true
				end
				if state.inset[edge] ~= 0 then
					atRest = false
				end
			end
			write(panel, state)
			if atRest then
				state.held = false
			end
		end
		return travelling
	end

	local function onFrame(deltaTime)
		if not dirty and not moving then
			return
		end
		if gui == nil or gui.Parent == nil then
			return
		end
		if dirty then
			dirty = false
			solve()
		end
		moving = advance(deltaTime)
	end

	-- The panel must size itself by its Size offsets alone, as the resize handles also require,
	-- and its content must scroll or reflow in whatever size is left.
	function W.allowPush(panel, minWidth, minHeight)
		local state = pushable[panel]
		if state then
			state.minWidth = minWidth
			state.minHeight = minHeight
			return
		end
		pushable[panel] = {
			minWidth = minWidth,
			minHeight = minHeight,
			held = false,
			inset = { Left = 0, Top = 0, Right = 0, Bottom = 0 },
			goal = { Left = 0, Top = 0, Right = 0, Bottom = 0 },
		}
	end

	function W.panelPushed(panel)
		local state = pushable[panel]
		return state ~= nil and state.held
	end

	function W.restingPosition(panel)
		local state = pushable[panel]
		if state and state.held then
			absorb(panel, state)
			return state.restPosition
		end
		return panel.Position
	end

	function W.restingSize(panel)
		local state = pushable[panel]
		if state and state.held then
			absorb(panel, state)
			return state.restSize
		end
		return panel.Size
	end

	function W.releasePushes()
		for panel, state in pairs(pushable) do
			if state.held and panel.Parent == gui then
				release(panel, state)
			end
		end
		dirty = true
	end

	-- Panels of an earlier build stay registered until collected; they are no longer under
	-- `gui` and are skipped.
	function W.watchPanelPush(screenGui)
		gui = screenGui
		tracked = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		arrivals = {}
		dirty = true
		moving = false
		if frameConnection then
			frameConnection:Disconnect()
		end
		frameConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(onFrame)
		table.insert(W.getUISConnections(), frameConnection)
	end
end

--[[
	PanelPush/Rules  -  the geometry of one panel giving way to another. Pure: no instances.
	A rect is { Left, Top, Right, Bottom } in screen pixels.
	  Rules.overlaps(rect, front) -> boolean
	  Rules.giveWay(rect, front, floorWidth, floorHeight, gap)
	      Moves one edge of `rect` inward, away from `front`. The edge is the one that clears
	      `front` (leaving `gap`) with the least travel while `rect` stays at least floorWidth by
	      floorHeight. When no edge can clear it, the edge with the least travel goes as far as
	      the floor allows.
]]

-- Rects that share less than this many pixels on an axis do not count as overlapping.
local TOUCH_TOLERANCE = 1

local Rules = {}

function Rules.overlaps(rect, front)
	local sharedWidth = math.min(rect.Right, front.Right) - math.max(rect.Left, front.Left)
	local sharedHeight = math.min(rect.Bottom, front.Bottom) - math.max(rect.Top, front.Top)
	return sharedWidth > TOUCH_TOLERANCE and sharedHeight > TOUCH_TOLERANCE
end

-- Inward travel that clears `front` for each edge, and how far the edge may travel at all.
local function options(rect, front, floorWidth, floorHeight, gap)
	local roomX = math.max(0, rect.Right - rect.Left - floorWidth)
	local roomY = math.max(0, rect.Bottom - rect.Top - floorHeight)
	return {
		{ edge = "Left", travel = front.Right + gap - rect.Left, room = roomX },
		{ edge = "Right", travel = rect.Right - (front.Left - gap), room = roomX },
		{ edge = "Top", travel = front.Bottom + gap - rect.Top, room = roomY },
		{ edge = "Bottom", travel = rect.Bottom - (front.Top - gap), room = roomY },
	}
end

function Rules.giveWay(rect, front, floorWidth, floorHeight, gap)
	local clearing = nil
	local nearest = nil
	for _, option in ipairs(options(rect, front, floorWidth, floorHeight, gap)) do
		if nearest == nil or option.travel < nearest.travel then
			nearest = option
		end
		if option.travel <= option.room and (clearing == nil or option.travel < clearing.travel) then
			clearing = option
		end
	end

	local chosen = clearing or nearest
	local travel = math.min(chosen.travel, chosen.room)
	if chosen.edge == "Left" then
		rect.Left += travel
	elseif chosen.edge == "Right" then
		rect.Right -= travel
	elseif chosen.edge == "Top" then
		rect.Top += travel
	else
		rect.Bottom -= travel
	end
end

return Rules
